apps.short_description: Step into the tantalizing world of online entertainment with "CamGirl Simulator"! This immersive simulation game puts you in control of your own virtual cam model career. Experience the highs and lows of the industry as you navigate the challenges and rewards of being a popular camgirl.

apps.name: Camille Queen of Chess bots
apps.short_description: Play chess against bots with real personalities  each bound by its own rules, moods, and game plans, not just a difficulty slider. Drill your openings, review every game, and climb from casual sparring to serious battles against the strong Camille engine. Fully offline.

apps.name: Carcelera
apps.short_description: Carcelera is a short exploration and light puzzle game. You are in prison, and so is the Moon. Forge your own destiny, you can repent later.

apps.name: Cardtographer
apps.short_description: Evil has returned! Complete the card collection to seal it away! Build synergistic decks for tactical battles. Survive procedurally generated roguelike runs—solo or in co-op—with danger lurking around every corner. Carve your path and become the cardtographer!

apps.name: Carry Bros: Find It Together
apps.short_description: Hide objects, search industrial locations, and outsmart the opposing team in a fast-paced online party game. Play as Hiders or Seekers, use special abilities and power-ups, and complete your objective before time runs out!

apps.name: Carry On Together
apps.short_description: Carry On Together is a physics-based online co-op moving game for up to 4 players. Run a tiny delivery company with your friends: lift heavy furniture together, drive the truck across town and deliver everything in one piece… or don’t. Can you keep the company alive?

apps.name: Castaway Slime
apps.short_description:
Castaway Slime is a survival game where a shipwrecked slime must survive 30 days until a rescue ship arrives.
The game features survival elements such as hunting, farming, cooking, and mining, along with RPG-style equipment, stats, and skills.
Online co-op supports up to 4 players.

apps.name: Castle Crew
apps.short_description: In a vast magical castle, everything has ended up out of place! Sort books, scrolls, runes, and potions, find where each item belongs, and watch as room after room transforms from total chaos into a satisfyingly organized space - on your own or with friends.

apps.name: Cats to Mars
apps.short_description: A strategic 2D physics game where you stack adorable cats to reach Mars. Use each cat's unique size and weight to build your tower as high as possible!

apps.name: Cemetery Simulator
apps.short_description: Carry the coffin with your crew and build the best necropolis! Dig graves, lower coffins, and keep everything tidy. Decorate the area to earn the prestige needed to unlock new sectors. Play solo or in co-op mode for up to 4 players, facing vandals and ghosts!

apps.name: Changer Seven
apps.short_description: 3D Single-Player Action-Adventure! Explore a Vibrant World, Recruit Colorful Teammates, and Swap them during Combo-Driven Battles! ❤️ A Love Letter to the Toku-Sentai, Shounen Anime, Mahou Shoujo, and Classic Morning Cartoon Shows of our Childhood!

apps.name: Chaos Agents
apps.short_description: Chaos Agents, designed by Richard Garfield, is the world’s first Autobattler Royale where every hero is one of a kind. Born with unique names, appearance, and skillsets you guide your Agent to victory by fusing the strategic planning of autobattlers with the tension and scale of a Battle Royale.

apps.name: Chefs Arena
apps.short_description: Chefs Arena is a competitive party game you can play with your friends, family or online strangers. Cook dishes from whacky ingredients, fight monsters, sabotage, steal and feed an ever-hungry King.

apps.name: Chess Town
apps.short_description: A cozy chess career simulation where every move matters. Shape your strategy with decision cards, rise through local tournaments, and work city jobs to build the life that supports your path to becoming a champion.

apps.name: Chesstris
apps.short_description:
Chess meets Tetris in a series of handcrafted puzzles. Drop chess pieces to checkmate rival kings while avoiding checkmating your own. Become a beloved champion or a despised victor, find true love or ruin friendships.
In Chesstris, your choices in and out of puzzles shape your destiny!

apps.name: ChickenPlaguePolice
apps.short_description: A deadly Chicken Plague has destroyed the world. As a guard of humanity’s last safe zone, you must inspect survivors seeking refuge and identify the infected. One mistake could doom the entire community, so examine everyone carefully before allowing them inside.

apps.name: Chill & Thrill - Deep Down
apps.short_description: Venture even deeper into the forest and track down the sentry! Enjoy the beginning and look forward to the "Entrance" to the "Guard Post" or the "Ruins" – lovingly and creatively designed by the developer!

apps.name: ChillTank
apps.short_description: Collect, care for, breed and trade colorful fish in a cozy aquarium game. Build your own 2.5D habitats from scratch: shape the landscape, add water and decorate a home for your fish. Play offline, at your own pace.

apps.name: Chronicles: Medieval
apps.short_description: Step into a vast, dynamic medieval sandbox set in the age of the Hundred Years' War. Explore a brutal but beautiful, historically grounded Europe, command armies in massive battles, leave a mark the chroniclers can't ignore as you make your name one fight at a time. What story will you write?

apps.name: Civil Twilight
apps.short_description: Go into a fog-sealed city every night and carry salvage back out. You only see what your flashlight touches, you can't shoot while your hands are full, and every gunshot calls the anomalies. Find an exit before sunrise. Solo or up to 4 players.

apps.name: CLACKPOT: Marble Bounce Roguelike
apps.short_description: A physics-based roguelike where you pull back a marble, let go, and score every time it bounces off a wall. Combine Patches to activate multiple Synergies, upgrade them and collect Relics to make a build of your own, then climb past rule-bending bosses to the final boss.

apps.name: Clean Start
apps.short_description: Clean and organize other people’s homes while uncovering emotional stories through the objects you find. Discover each room’s unique history, dig up secrets, and feel the satisfaction of tidying up the space in this wholesome, casual puzzle game about new beginnings in a foreign country.

apps.name: Clerks and Quirks
apps.short_description: Run a magical shop where your appliances are alive, emotional, and doing their best to ruin your day. Tame them to unlock powerful bonuses in this chaotic co-op roguelite: cook dishes, craft gear, and serve demanding customers as you scramble through the weekly rush, solo or with up to 4 friends.

apps.name: CloserLook VR: Oldways
apps.short_description: CloserLook VR: Oldways is a story-driven VR adventure set in modern-day West Africa. Trapped in a university building, explore secret locations, solve puzzles, and uncover a gripping narrative of exploitation, corruption, and betrayal.

apps.name: Coin Harvest
apps.short_description: Robotic arms sweep a steady pour of coins off your plateau. Unlock islands, conquer six realms and ascend for crystals in an idle game that sits on your desktop while you work or play.

apps.name: Construction Simulator: Evolution
apps.short_description: Dig into the next exciting evolution of the Construction Simulator series and experience the biggest construction playground ever. Control numerous licensed machines, take on manual labor, and master both construction and demolition.

apps.name: Corebound
apps.short_description: Fight, build and engineer your way through five stages to protect a living energy Core. Corebound mixes twin-stick combat with deckbuilding, tower defence and a production network — every card, tower and weapon changes what the other three can do.

apps.name: Corner Dungeon
apps.short_description: Lightweight desktop idle battler. The ultimate workday distraction.

apps.name: Corridor Duel
apps.short_description: A competitive 3D strategy board game. Outmaneuver rivals with clever movement and walls in local, online, AI, 4-player, team, and chaotic Crazy Mode matches.

apps.name: Crack Surgeons 🍑
apps.short_description: 🍑 Crack Surgeons is a chaotic co-op surgery game for 1 to 4 backyard doctors. Shrink down, venture inside patients deemed unsaveable by traditional medicine, and cure bizarre ailments from the inside out. Which way you go in is up to you! 🍑

apps.name: CrashCrash
apps.short_description: Clock in with Destruction Squad for the world's most questionable demolition jobs! Team up in online co-op for up to 4 players, grab bizarre tools, and wreck physics-driven worksites. Efficiency is everything, safety is optional... just don't demolish your teammates!

apps.name: CRETE
apps.short_description:
Fight against the Ancestors and other biopunk creatures. Use their DNA to build your own procedural weapons, find a friend and combine your skills to be even more powerful.
The further you go, the better rewards you will get for the next run. It is up to you to reveal what is up there in the north.

apps.name: Crispy Circuits
apps.short_description: Discover the world of electronics by fixing your hamster’s RC plane. Build real circuits, solve increasingly challenging engineering puzzles, and learn how electronic devices actually work. This wholesome circuitry sim lets you electrocute your hamster without authorities getting involved.

apps.name: Critical Ward
apps.short_description: Treat patients, build massive combos, create absurd builds, deploy automated medical infrastructure, and survive the escalating arcade chaos before hospital saturation reaches 100%.

apps.name: Croak
apps.short_description:
Tongue-grapple and pinball-bounce the frog prince across levels to reach the Witch’s Banquet in this hand-drawn 2D platformer. Each whimsical world has its own wacky boss, hidden collectibles, and a unique traversal ability. Grit your teeth! You're gonna CROAK.
-DEMO OUT NOW!-

apps.name: Crude Empire
apps.short_description: Build an oil empire in boomtown Texas: find oil, drill the well yourself, lay pipelines, refine gasoline and run your own gas stations. Every stage can become the bottleneck, and rival oil companies fight you for every field and every customer.

apps.name: CRUSH LOAD
apps.short_description: Pilot an armoured mech through fifteen minutes of the horde. Choose where to move and what to pick up as your weapons fire automatically. Seven zones, seven colossi, twenty-one weapon lines: equip five, evolve them, and push one to its apex.

apps.name: Crypts Of Carith
apps.short_description: Explore the village of Carith, dank sewers, forgotten cellars, and ancient tombs, battle deadly creatures, and uncover powerful loot in this classic party-based dungeon crawling RPG built on a familiar D20 system.

apps.name: Cthulhu Keeper
apps.short_description: In this Lovecraftian real-time tactics game you play as a 1920s cult leader on a mission from the Old Ones. Build your cult, summon eldritch monsters, and undertake stealth tactics missions to spread insanity and amass power! In CTHULHU KEEPER you are the cosmic horror.

apps.name: Cucina Stellata
apps.short_description: Cook traditional 19th-century Italian recipes in a kitchen haunted by hunger. A short psychological horror where gastronomy, ritual and cosmic appetite share the same table.

apps.name: Cursed To Move
apps.short_description: `Cursed To Move is a dark chess roguelite where every run rewrites the rules. Upgrade your pieces with game-breaking abilities, choose your path through battles, shops and bosses, and keep your king alive as the board collapses around you.

apps.name: CYBERBIKES
apps.short_description: CYBERBIKES is an intense vehicular combat game where you pilot a futuristic motorbike armed with classified tech. Tune and upgrade your custom ride to outgun a ruthless syndicate, battling to reclaim the streets across scale-accurate recreations of iconic locations like Paris, Kyoto, Giza and more!

apps.name: DAEMON
apps.short_description: Hatch one egg on your desktop and raise the little pet inside. Pet him until his eyes close, dress him in hats, give him a bed, and send him to sleep over at a friend's PC while you peek in. He learns from the way you live, and a month later he's like no other pet on earth.

apps.name: Dali's Adventure: Lost Worlds
apps.short_description: A mysterious vortex pulls you out of reality. Play as Max, trapped between unknown worlds. Explore, observe, and solve puzzles to progress… but something may try to stop you. 🎮 Demo available — add it to your wishlist.

apps.name: Danchi Days
apps.short_description: A slice-of-life adventure with a comedic-yet-bittersweet story set in a 2000s Japanese neighborhood! Play as 12-year-old Hoshino, revive a summer festival, reconnect with neighbors, and uncover truths about her grandma living with dementia.

apps.name: Danger Mouse
apps.short_description: Play as Danger Mouse or Penfold through 15 side scrolling, arcade battle action, super danger filled levels - all to stop the latest evil plan by Baron Greenback!

apps.name: Dark Ruins: Nine Dragons Pulling the Coffin
apps.short_description: Dark Ruins is a thrilling idle looter auto-battler! Train heroes to escort the 9-dragon Coffin through 20 monster waves per stage. Every wave drops loot, and you keep 100% of items even on defeat! With 1-of-3 skill upgrades, a huge talent tree, NG+, and an AI assistant handling chores.

apps.name: Darkest Darkness
apps.short_description: Darkest Darkness is a roguelike deck-building game with extraction elements. Choose your identity and venture into a Lovecraftian town. Craft every card yourself—collect materials, build powerful cards, plan your route, or extract with your gathered materials to gain an edge in your next run.

apps.name: Dash and Smash
apps.short_description: Dash and Smash is a chaotic party brawler where players clash in fast-paced, physics-driven battles. Choose unique characters and Dash and Smash your way to victory, locally with friends or online!

apps.name: Dashoot: ABYA's Adventure
apps.short_description: Dashoot: ABYA's Adventure is a pixel-art precision platformer. Fire your floating cannon to trigger switches and move platforms. Grab items to dash with varying charges, directions and distances. Chart a path underground, restart power stations, and uncover the AI Deus's secrets.

apps.name: Dataclysm
apps.short_description: Embark on a journey into the heart of a digital kingdom unlike any other. Dataclysm invites you to explore a world where ancient data comes alive, and every line of code tells a story waiting to be unraveled.

apps.name: Dawn Archive
apps.short_description: Choose rooms. Rotate them. Connect your path. Shape a mysterious mansion in this exploration and puzzle adventure. With limited steps and keys, solve puzzles and follow clues in forgotten records to reach the archive deep within.

apps.name: Dawn of Defense
apps.short_description:
Dawn of Defense blends RTS, Tower Defense, and Roguelite progression. In a last defense, lead your tribe against the Empire: 
Command warriors in battle, fortify defenses, and build an economy as you fight to reclaim your ancestral homeland.

apps.name: De Potrero
apps.short_description: You are a footballer, straight from the youth ranks until your last season. One decision at a time: when to shoot, when to pass, what to say to the press. A whole career decided by what you choose, and a little by your luck.

apps.name: Deadgate
apps.short_description: Take a contract onto a quarantined island overrun by zombies. Loot what you can carry, outlast rival squads and reach your exit before midnight, or lose everything you brought. A first-person extraction shooter for up to 32 players. No contract, no exit.

apps.name: Deathand
apps.short_description: The sorcerer Velkorin has cursed the land, and only you are mad enough to go down after him. Crawl his dungeon tile by tile with a single card burning in your hand for light. Every fight is a card battle, and every card you burn to see by is one you cannot fight with.

apps.name: Deckromancer: Haven and Hell
apps.short_description: A fast-paced deckbuilding action roguelite where every run is shaped by the cards you draw. Build powerful synergies, cast spells, summon allies and switch between Haven and Hell while battling a dynamic Fate Deck that unleashes deadly enemies, hazards and unexpected events.

apps.name: Deep Drift Fishing
apps.short_description: Drop your line into the uncharted abyss! Dodge exotic aquatic fauna on your descent, snag high-value specimens on the reel-up, and survive encounters with mythical Apex predators. Upgrade your winch, harness burst nets, and unlock new oceans in this fast-paced arcade deep-sea fishing adventure.

apps.name: DEEPWARD
apps.short_description: Choose three heroes from a roster of six and switch between them instantly during combat. Each has their own health, weapon and ability. DEEPWARD is a fast horror FPS roguelite set in an alternate 1920s, where keeping your squad alive means fighting through the madness. Hero death is permanent.

apps.name: DELIVERX
apps.short_description: Packages won’t deliver themselves! Jump into your van with up to 4 friends, drive out to a massive shifting facility, and retrieve high-value cargo from deadly horrors. Every run is unpredictable. Deliver at all costs. Have a fearless delivery!

apps.name: DerbiManager
apps.short_description: Take charge of a club, sit in the dugout and answer to the board. Transfers you have to negotiate, a youth academy, finances, training and scouts. And at kick-off you choose: the final score right away, or the match in 3D, to watch or to play yourself. 1,000 clubs, 60 leagues, 47 countries.

apps.name: Deslot
apps.short_description: A realistic miniature racing game featuring Die-Cast, Slot, and Mini RC cars. Master momentum, throttle, and precision driving across handcrafted and procedurally generated diorama tracks. Build your own circuits, customize your cars, and race through Career, Challenges, and Multiplayer.

apps.name: Desperate Survival
apps.short_description: Descend into dark mines with your crawler. Fight, venture beyond the light, and rebuild your gear with modular cubes. A voxel action roguelite about branching routes, growing danger, and lasting progress back at camp.

apps.name: Deuce Agency 2027
apps.short_description: Run a tennis agency, not a player. Scout unknown juniors, negotiate contracts and sponsorships, plan every player's season across a 52-week world tour, and give tactical orders between sets — a deep management sim built on how professional tennis really makes money.

apps.name: Dinosaur Survival Simulator - Prehistoric RPG
apps.short_description: Survive as a dinosaur in a dangerous prehistoric world. Hunt, hide, and grow from a fragile hatchling to a powerful predator. Explore diverse biomes, battle rivals and T-Rex, and unlock new species in this ultimate survival evolution experience.

apps.name: Dog Eat Fly
apps.short_description: Dog Eat Fly is a colorful 2D roguelite platformer where you run, jump, dash and eat flies. Build powerful combinations of upgrades, survive increasingly chaotic challenges, and push your run further with every attempt.

apps.name: Don't Fret
apps.short_description: A sentient guitar trapped inside a nightmare music school. Hide, distract, and survive horrifying creatures as you tune your way through musical puzzles and fractured memories to uncover the truth.

apps.name: DOOD
apps.short_description: Bring your drawings to life with eyes, legs, wings, and other parts, then set them loose on the Junk Planet in this sandbox ecosystem sim. Breed and fuse surprising new creatures, tackle strange research requests, and recreate the lost ecosystem of Sage’s home planet.

apps.name: Doodle Wars: Ink and Paper
apps.short_description: Hand-drawn auto-battler on ink and paper. Open a pack, build a five-card army of stick troops, and let them duel for the rival tower. You do not steer the units: you design the deck. Campaign versus AI and online PvP.

apps.name: Dragon Decimator
apps.short_description: A Clicker Game about Slaying a Dragon that Won't Take Forever to Complete! If it can bleed, it can die.

apps.name: Dragona: Fireborne
apps.short_description: A PC free-to-play MMORPG set in the cursed realm of Bartan. As a Dragona warrior, transform into mighty dragons to face Jurtan's influence. Immerse in rich lore, landscapes, and battles against darkness. Unleash the Dragona within and rise in this dark fantasy adventure. Bartan's fate awaits.

apps.name: Dread Rune
apps.short_description: A roguelike RPG inspired by Pixel Dungeon. Choose from 12 heroes, explore ever-changing dungeons, and master 130+ items that wear down with use. Every run is a test of combat skill, strategy, and knowing when to use what you've got.

apps.name: Drift Riot
apps.short_description: Drift Riot is an arcade racer where style is speed. Chain drifts, jumps and near misses into huge scores, outrun the Patrols in Heat Run, conquer 150 career courses, race leaderboard ghosts, and build tracks to share.

apps.name: Drive Thru Fast Food Simulator
apps.short_description: Run your own first-person drive-thru restaurant 🍔 Take orders, cook in real time, manage supplies, clean your kitchen, and serve cars under pressure. Balance speed, precision, and reputation to turn your small fast-food spot into the city’s favorite.

apps.name: DROSS
apps.short_description:
DROSS is a procedurally Generated FPS, set in a derelict facility infested with alien bugs.
Explore, collect powerful weapons and equipment, to upgrade your gear and fight the Dross.

apps.name: Drunk Dork On Pitchfork
apps.short_description: Drunk Dork on Pitchfork is a unique rage arcade game. Play as an Imp dragging a hefty Dork through hellish traps & mazes to throw the ultimate party! Control both characters with special fork mechanic – keep yourself and your living cargo alive while he slipping away into lava!

apps.name: Drunkonauts
apps.short_description: Drunkonauts is a chaotic multiplayer party game with hilarious physics-based combat, crazy weapons and JETPACKS! Battle friends in local or online matches, use unpredictable movement and wacky attacks to send opponents flying, stay on the map, avoid dangerous hazards and claim victory!

apps.name: Drunkslop: Pub crawl COOP
apps.short_description: DRUNKSLOP: 100% Chaos. 0% Hangover. The only co-op where getting totally wasted is the actual win condition. Scavenge for cash, chug drinks, make terrible choices, and somehow clutch it out. Strap in, it’s a long-ass night.

apps.name: Dungebra
apps.short_description: Dungebra is a dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder where you choose multiple cards at once, trigger Combo, Overload and Sequence, build your deck during the run, and turn every turn into an explosive play.

apps.name: E36 and the gang
apps.short_description: A driving and drifting game about good roads, big skids, and having a good time behind the wheel.

apps.name: EchoNet
apps.short_description: A short psychological horror game, where you and your team attempt to prevent a global economic crash.

apps.name: Edroseph's Tower
apps.short_description: A dark fantasy turn-based roguelike RPG with 25 classes and deep buildcraft. Climb the tower solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players, combine talents and equipment, and adapt your party to every run.

apps.name: Ego Lifting Simulator
apps.short_description: A physics-driven lifting career sim where you physically control every rep. Train hard, train smart, manage your work-life balance and diet, and become the next lifting champion.

apps.name: Eldritch Break
apps.short_description: Vibrant, high-octane 2.5D Boomer Shooter that smashes together the fast-paced action of classics like Doom and Duke Nukem with the mind-bending, non-Euclidean environments of an eldritch prison.

apps.name: Embrace Of The Embers
apps.short_description:
Remember, what you see may not be real; what you believe may not be correct. 

This is not just an adventure to escape a nightmare, but also a journey questioning love, guilt, and loss. 

Welcome home, Arthur.
developers: Hunan Xinghe Yingchuang Digital Technology Co., Ltd.
publishers: Hunan Xinghe Yingchuang Digital Technology Co., Ltd.

apps.name: Emissary One
apps.short_description: Co-op horror (1 to 6+ players). The squad was sent to the next site, but contact was lost. Find them and team up for the current mission. It seems you're not alone here again.

apps.name: Empty The Lake!
apps.short_description: Empty the lake, make money, and discover what’s hidden at the bottom! Pump out thousands of liters of water, upgrade your tools, and keep going deeper to uncover what lies beneath the surface.

apps.name: Enginefall
apps.short_description: Session based survival where players upgrade and live aboard their own personal trains. Team up with friends, make new ones or go solo. Board colossal Titan Trains to fight, build, craft, gather and steal much needed resources. Fortify and stock your personal train fortress. Will you survive?

apps.name: Engines Of Destruction
apps.short_description:
Engines of Destruction is a mech simulator.
Take on the role of pilot, create your own custom mechs, fight in PvP or PvE battles, and control a fully interactive cockpit in VR or on desktop.

apps.name: Entered
apps.short_description:
Entered ■■■■■■■...
A retro-style horror visual novel branching into various horror subgenres.

apps.name: Escape From Necromaze
apps.short_description: During a night date, your girlfriend is snatched by an evil Necromancer! With 0 combat power and no weapons, your only hope is lightning-fast reflexes and spatial memory. EA features 15 levels. Delve into the trap-laden dungeon, dodge undead, and save your love in the ultimate showdown!

apps.name: Escape the Baby Alarm
apps.short_description: Parenthood as told through a cozy, psychedelic, puzzle adventure. Solve hand-drawn escape room-inspired puzzles inside a baby alarm. Find your way out through mashed peas, pacifiers and sleepless nights. Funny, heartfelt, and beautifully illustrated.

apps.name: Escape the Space Hotel
apps.short_description: Stranded in a luxury space hotel orbiting 400 km above Earth, Max Reed must solve mind-bending puzzles to survive. Explore stunning zero-gravity decks, hack systems, and make life-or-death choices in this classic 2D point-and-click sci-fi adventure packed with 100+ clever puzzles, can you Escape?

apps.name: Escape the Walls
apps.short_description: You're surrounded by walls. All you have on you is your hands. You have to punch your way through, no other choice.

apps.name: Escape Together: Prison Break
apps.short_description: Dig a secret tunnel and escape a heavily guarded prison. Play solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players. Hide your operation from guards, dispose of dirt, trade valuable finds, upgrade your tools, and plan the escape using proximity voice chat.

apps.name: EscapeNET
apps.short_description: Survive in first person, deadly AI-controlled chambers in EscapeNET, where players must cooperate as humans and drones, solve deadly puzzles, and face off in high-stakes PvP arenas — all under relentless time pressure.

apps.name: Eugene Onegin vs. the Undead
apps.short_description: An HD-remaster of a comedy-horror visual novel from 2009, mixing classical Russian literature with anime, zombies and glam rock.

apps.name: Everfront
apps.short_description: Lead a nation through a roguelike strategy campaign where borders grow continuously. Choose your path, unlock technology and push the front.

apps.name: Evergrind
apps.short_description: Evergrind is an idle adventure like you've never experienced before! Discover unknown regions, face dangerous creatures, and create the ultimate loot loop. Master skills, process rare resources, and forge powerful gear on your journey to absolute perfection!

apps.name: Everlast
apps.short_description: On Everlast: Undying Tale’s magical world of Sarkis, the undead have risen. Gather, explore, skill, and craft in this MMO-Lite Action RPG Adventure. Only by bridging the gap between the living and the dead can you break Death’s curse.

apps.name: Evil Among Shadows: Hollow Creek
apps.short_description: After Kevin's disappearance, Sam stays with her aunt and uncle to support them after the loss of their son. She and her friend Anthony soon stumble down the same rabbit hole as her cousin did, growing increasingly obsessed with proving there is a serial killer lurking in Hollow Creek.

apps.name: Exoborne
apps.short_description: Exoborne is an open-world, tactical extraction shooter set in a world torn apart by extreme forces of nature. Customize powerful exo-rigs to gain strategic advantage in ever-changing weather conditions. Face hostile factions, enemy players, and Mother Nature herself in intense high-stakes sessions.

apps.name: ExoFlora First Seeds
apps.short_description: Grow alien plants in an abandoned greenhouse, pair neighbors that react in fire, frost and light, and breed new species you get to name. Tune the climate, explore the valley with robot spheres and hold the line when the pest swarms arrive.

apps.name: Expedition: Into Darkness
apps.short_description: Brave forbidden dungeons in a quest for knowledge and treasure in this medieval PvE co-op extraction looter. Craft weapons, customise gear and join forces with up to four allies. Survive the ruins together—or lose everything you carry.

apps.name: Experiment 15
apps.short_description: Experiment 15 is a two-player online co-op psychological horror puzzle game where you share control of a single body. One controls the body, the other the mind. Communicate, combine what each of you can perceive, and survive a series of disturbing experiments.

apps.name: Fablery
apps.short_description: Take control of legendary Heroes from myths, tales, and legends of every culture. Each Hero has a unique deck reflecting their personality and powers. Enter a tactical card game where strategy and foresight turn every battle into an unforgettable story.

apps.name: Factory Survival
apps.short_description: Build and create automated factories to produce items of increasing complexity, within an infinite 3D world. Use your imagination to design your factory, combine simple elements into ingenious structures, and finally escape from creatures who don't really like you.

apps.name: Fakin It XL
apps.short_description: In Fakin’ It XL, one player, the Faker, never gets the prompt and has to bluff their way through. Choose in-room or remote play up front, and get round types built for either. New content, new question types, same lying and grilling you love.

apps.name: Farm Bang
apps.short_description: Raise living ammo, blast monsters, haul massive loot, and survive the debt collectors in this chaotic top-down farming shooter.

apps.name: Farm Simulator 2026
apps.short_description: Build and grow your own modern farm in Farm Simulator 2026. Cultivate fields, harvest crops, raise animals, operate powerful machinery, and expand your farming business across a large open world with dynamic weather and a day-night cycle.

apps.name: Farmer's Diary
apps.short_description: There is a lot of work to be done on this farm. A long-term adventure awaits you where you can take farming and orcharding to the next level with your friends.

apps.name: Farmion
apps.short_description: Build your dream farm and grow a village around it in this cozy voxel farming and life sim, solo or with friends. Grow crops, raise animals, and turn your harvest into meals, bouquets and cheese for your own café, grocery store and flower shop. Your farm keeps growing while you’re away.

apps.name: Fart Together
apps.short_description: Fart Together is a physics-based co-op parkour game where 2–4 players steer the same boat using fart power, with competitive modes supporting up to 8 players. Coordinate your direction, timing, and gas power with friends to overcome challenging obstacle courses.

apps.name: Fate & Felt
apps.short_description: Fate & Felt is a single-player poker roguelite built on Texas Hold’em. Read opponents, manage chips, and choose when to check, call, raise, fold, or go all-in. Roll skill dice and combine character abilities, Magic cards, Jokers, and shifting rules through three chapters and four modes.

apps.name: FEED ME MORE BRAINS
apps.short_description:
A silly first-person incremental game about feeding an ancient god with brains.
Grab, throw and automate their delivery as you unlock mutations, summon loyal cultists, and transform your temple into the ultimate brain-feeding machine.

apps.name: Fellowship of the Oak
apps.short_description: Fellowship of the Oak is a cozy crafting sim where you gather a fellowship of heroes, providing them with everything they need to succeed on their adventures. Build cozy homes, craft gear, farm provisions and manage expeditions in order to collect powerful loot!

apps.name: Final Depth
apps.short_description: Navigate through the dungeon in this modernized traditional fantasy roguelike fighting monsters, gathering loot and leveling your character as you try to make it to the Final Depth.

apps.name: Fire Isle
apps.short_description: A cozy, turn-based strategy party-game for 1–4 players where everyone moves at once. Spread fire across a new hex island every match, block rivals, set traps and race for Wisps, the key to victory. Play online with friends or solo against bots.

apps.name: Firefighting Rescue Simulator
apps.short_description: Step into the boots of a firefighter in Firefighting Rescue Simulator. Drive fire trucks, battle intense blazes, rescue civilians, and use advanced tools across three cities. Every mission tests your speed, skill, and courage.

apps.name: FishIdle
apps.short_description: A multiplayer idle RPG. Queue gathering, crafting, and combat — your character keeps going on the server. Standard and Hardcore are separate paths; five classes fight on autopilot.

apps.name: Fishing Up
apps.short_description: Catch 48 unique fish and complete collections in a relaxing fishing game. Explore different locations, use various baits and rods, and enjoy a peaceful angling experience.

apps.name: Fishing Up The Food Chain
apps.short_description: Catch a fish and you become the fish. Catch a car, become the car. Fish your way up a gloriously silly food chain, from one soggy fisherman to the entire universe, in a hand-drawn pixel-art fishing game full of googly eyes, upgrades and one very weird portal.

apps.name: Fleshgrinder
apps.short_description:
Fleshgrinder is an isometric post-apocalyptic Action-RPG.
Take on the desperate mission to stop the Fleshgrinder from causing planetary extinction by harvesting the infected population.
Loot, equip and level up your characters, interact with npcs in a persistent world filled with quests and danger.

apps.name: Flock Off!
apps.short_description: Flock Off! is a first-person action-adventure game for 1–4 players. Team up with friends to survive a strange and woolly uprising in the remote Scottish Highlands. Improvise with oddball weapons to fend off mutant sheep and uncover unexpected twists. Will you survive the Sheepocalypse?

apps.name: Flow Water 3D Puzzle
apps.short_description: Move blocks, channels and pipes to guide colorful streams of water to their fountains in 1,350 handcrafted 3D logic puzzles. Relax, think and solve increasingly challenging levels.

apps.name: Football Manager 27
apps.short_description: Flow from the tactics board to the touchline as foundations evolve to deliver greater control, smoother discovery and a more enticing football world. Out from November 10.

apps.name: Forgery Craft
apps.short_description: Master the art of forgery in this story-driven simulation game. Start with altering documents by changing single signatures and dates. End up forging entire art pieces that could fool any museum expert.

apps.name: Formula Z: Controlled Dose
apps.short_description: Build your pharmacy, manufacture unapproved Formula Z drugs, sell them on the streets or to hospitals, rob stores at night, evade the FDZ, and expand your business across four eras in this first-person pharmacy and business simulation.

apps.name: Fruitopia
apps.short_description: FRUITOPIA is an original casual game for Deathmatch competition

apps.name: Gacha Shop Simulator
apps.short_description: Run a cozy gacha shop! Sell blind boxes and figures, serve customers, expand your store and open a few boxes for yourself. Who knows what rare figure is waiting inside?

apps.name: Game About Breaking A Cube
apps.short_description: Take on the role of a factory worker oppressed by an evil corporation. Break stranger and stranger cubes in pursuit of ore and truth. Upgrade your tools, explore the underground facility and learn the secret of NullCorp. Later, relax at home with a cold can of drinkable meat.

apps.name: Game of Thrones: War for Westeros
apps.short_description: Classic real-time strategy in the world of Westeros. Conquer the Seven Kingdoms solo, or dominate your enemies to claim the Iron Throne in multiplayer skirmish. Command the Great Houses, rally iconic heroes, and rewrite the fate of the realm.

apps.name: Gang of Frogs
apps.short_description: Sail through the galaxy as a fearless outlaw frog. Plunder loot, upgrade weapons, eat flies and fight through hordes of monstrous bugs in an intense 1-4 player co-op shooter.

apps.name: Garden Of Being
apps.short_description: Garden of Being is a hand-drawn oil pastel art game and a quiet journal of moods. Plant flowers, dedicate gardens to loved ones, and create downloadable prints. A fusion of art and code where gardens come alive while you are in them, and wait silently when you leave.

apps.name: Gateholt
apps.short_description: Gateholt is a co-op horror game for 1-4 players. Enter a cursed place and erase the marks an evil spirit has left behind. Every mark you erase brings it closer. You cannot fight it — run, or hide. The way back is still open.

apps.name: Geareo
apps.short_description: Real gears that don't slip in a mechanical invention sandbox. Build freely with resizable parts and shapes, overcome physics challenges, and follow kit instructions. Unleash your engineering creativity with intricate clockwork contraptions, steam-powered systems, and fully functional circuits.

apps.name: Ghost in the SQL Data
apps.short_description: A call reported a school fire 14 minutes before the first witness saw it. Find out who made it, in SQL, by exploring a year of Paris emergency calls.

apps.name: Gnomes Go Boom
apps.short_description: Garden gnomes vs. gardeners. Gnomes run screaming "lolololo", then freeze into a perfect ceramic statue among 300 identical ones. Gardeners hunt in first person with a water sprayer: statues drip, live gnomes steam. Spray the right one before it goes BOOM. 2–10 players online.

apps.name: Goddle
apps.short_description: A party word game where everyone plays from their phone. No app, no extra controllers: scan, type, score. Any number of players, six game modes, mix languages in the same round, and build your own dictionaries.

apps.name: Godreaper
apps.short_description: Godreaper is a dark third-person action-adventure where the fate of your homeland hangs in the balance. As the bogatyr Zaremire, explore every corner of a world inspired by East Slavic mythology. Defeat the creatures of Navi, battle almighty gods and save your homeland from inevitable destruction.

apps.name: Golden Tides
apps.short_description: Forget everything you know about MOBAs. Gather your crew and charge into explosive 4v4 battles across land and sea in Golden Tides. Whether you sail for glory or just for the chaos, every 20–25 minute voyage brings unpredictable encounters, epic ship battles, and tales worth telling at the tavern.

apps.name: Golf With Your Friends 2
apps.short_description:
Golf With Your Friends is back, and this time it means fore.

Up to 12 players, Chaos Mode, a new level editor, and enough questionable shots to end any friendship.

apps.name: GONE DIGGING
apps.short_description: Dig together by day. Feed the darkness by night. A 1–4 player co-op digging thriller where loot, upgrades, and sacrifices decide who survives after sundown.

apps.name: Grand Vista Hotel
apps.short_description: Build and manage a growing hotel. Earn stars, upgrade rooms and elevators, add restaurants, spas, conferences and events, and transform a small family hotel into a luxury Palace.

apps.name: GraveDiggers
apps.short_description: You and up to five friends play undertaker cats with one job: bury the dead. Find the bodies, keep your coffins away from a necromancer, fight what stands in your way, dig the graves and eat cheese whenever you can.

apps.name: Grenade! : Pang Pang Survive!
apps.short_description: A party game for up to 8 players where the crowd throws grenades, bombs and food onto the field. Catch grenades and throw them back to survive, and mix kart races, football, basketball, hockey, beach volleyball and obstacle courses into the same match.

apps.name: GrimKeep
apps.short_description: GrimKeep is a roguelite dice-builder in a nightmare fairytale. Find items, roll your dice, and optimize your build to fire off massive damage. Cut through the horrors in the cursed city to get to the Princess. Then end her.

apps.name: Grinner's Diner
apps.short_description: A co-op horror cooking game for 2 to 4 players, also playable solo. Grill burgers and fry tenders at a roadside diner in the Appalachian hills. By day it's a rush. After dark, cryptids come to the window, and something in the woods is waiting for the lights to go out.

apps.name: Guardians of the Wall
apps.short_description: Guardians of the Wall is a co-op action RPG where players fight through hordes and bosses beyond humanity’s last fortress. Fast hack-and-slash combat, unique heroes, and dynamic progression await.

apps.name: Guardians of the Wild Sky
apps.short_description: Survive, build, craft and explore a vast magical world as you capture and bond with powerful Guardians. Captain your own airship and sail the cloud seas. Build everything from cozy homes to flying castles. Explore this world solo or with friends; the skies are yours to conquer!

apps.name: Gunfire & Magic - Desktop Co-op Extraction!
apps.short_description:
A co-op idle minimalist desktop extraction game you can play with friends!

In a city destroyed by a strange force, many factions covet advanced science and magic—and you step into this land of opportunity. Fight, search, extract, grow stronger, build your base, and uncover your origins!

apps.name: Hack You
apps.short_description: Desktop hacking and social engineering in a moral thriller. Write viruses, hide them in game builds, crack other people's PCs — to get to the former friend who stole your life and built a new success on its ruins.

apps.name: Handle with Care
apps.short_description: A co-op delivery game where you play as tiny postal workers in a town that’s trying to kill you. Deliver everything from coffins to ticking bombs, escape rabid dogs and berserk drivers, and stay in business for six days to earn your pint on Sunday.

apps.name: HARVEST CLAUSE
apps.short_description: A farming action game: fight crop-eating monsters with modified farm tools, defend your fields, and sneak past security robots to harvest. On this planet, the fields and the workers all belong to the company, and your pay vanishes into absurd deductions.

apps.name: HENTAI CHAMELEON
apps.short_description: "Hentai Chameleon" puts your hide and seek skills to the test! Play as a sexy anime girl, pose, and paint yourself to hide in the level's environment. Or play as the male team to find the girls, and catch them to get their "special reward"💕💦Up to 8 players supported! Paint yourself and blend away!

apps.name: Hereditas
apps.short_description: Found your house or lead one of eight noble families in a medieval realm. Raise a castle stone by stone, furnish its halls, command companions and armies, and win the crown through war, trade and diplomacy – or hold what you built against every siege.

apps.name: hexGame: Hero Path
apps.short_description: The world needs a hero — choose yours. Any NPC can become the chosen one. Explore a living, procedurally generated hex world, carve your own path, craft unique combinations of weapons, tools, and relics, and fight through relentless hordes in fast-paced combat. Every run is different.

apps.name: Highway Station Simulator
apps.short_description: Run a highway station with up to four players. Somebody has to work the pumps, somebody has to stock the shelves, and somebody has to answer for the mess. A first-person co-op management sim about a very long shift.

apps.name: Homegrown: Sports Agent Empire
apps.short_description: Run a sports agency, not a team. Recruit stars across four leagues, negotiate under real salary-cap rules, survive scandals and holdouts, then retire to an interactive career review and post your score to the monthly global leaderboard. Premium, no microtransactions.

apps.name: Hordeguard: Winds of the North
apps.short_description: Leap into the heart of a Viking fantasy siege where tower defense meets action combat, strategy, and co-op survival. Gather what you can, raise your defenses, fight beside your friends, and hold the line against an unending horde.

apps.name: Horizon Hunters Gathering
apps.short_description: Hunt deadly machines in tactical co-op action and adapt your Hunter for intense missions.

apps.name: Hostile Architect
apps.short_description:
Who is the deranged mind behind those trap-filled stages from classic 2D side-scrolling games? This time, it's you.

Your kingdom is being invaded by heroes. You have to construct the stages they will traverse in this fast-paced 2D tower defense game.

apps.name: Hot Meals Fast Wheels
apps.short_description: A co-op cooking game where small mistakes quickly turn into chaos. Go shopping, cook in your food truck, and drive through the city to deliver orders on time.

apps.name: House Rules 21
apps.short_description: Blackjack, but every dealer plays by their own house rules. Work your way through nine dealers, each bending the rules of 21 in a different direction, build your bankroll, and unlock the modifiers, side bets, and card backs that turn a simple hand into a full run.

apps.name: How to grow a man
apps.short_description: A 17+ BL raising sim where you decide who leads. Spend four years on classes, part-time jobs, and questionable outfits, then romance seven very different men. Your stats determine whether you end up on top or bottom, and your choices unlock dozens of endings.

apps.name: Howling Woods
apps.short_description: A cozy Halloween town builder. Lay out paths and plots in a clearing in the woods and the town takes care of the rest: crooked houses go up, curio shops open, and goblins, ghosts and witches move in. The spookier your town gets, the grander it grows. Nothing costs a thing. Every day is Halloween!

apps.name: Hubble Bubble
apps.short_description: Co-op hookah shop sim for 1 to 4 friends. Run Ghalyan's Hookah Lounge on a space station: pack the bowl, light the coals, serve the aliens and act normal. Nothing on this station is normal.

apps.name: Hunting Simulator 3
apps.short_description: This open-world game lets you experience the thrill of the hunt, with your faithful dog by your side! Choose your equipment from official brands, and explore the wilderness in search of your next game.

apps.name: HYPE:Highschool Yokai Patrol & Exorcism
apps.short_description: A 1–4 player online co-op comedy-horror where you and your friends are running a highschool occult club. Chase rumors by day, sneak into the warped school at night to hunt a yokai, then Tape Seal its cursed object before everything goes wrong.

apps.name: I Buried Steve
apps.short_description: Eight players build a lethal beach obstacle course, then all eight have to survive it. Think Ultimate Chicken Horse crossed with Fall Guys, with axes, artillery and a Sharknado. Draft the traps, rig the sand, then run for your life as the water rises.

apps.name: IKUMA - The Frozen Compass
apps.short_description: Embark on a haunting journey into the cold in this narrative adventure - either alone or with a friend. IKUMA tells the story of Sam, a teenage boy who finds himself stranded in the Arctic with his dog. He must face not only its harsh environment, but also something lurking deeper in the shadows.

apps.name: ILL
apps.short_description: A realistic first-person action horror game that takes you into a dark fort overtaken by a mysterious entity. Unpredictable monsters, a visceral dismemberment system, and realistic physics create an atmosphere of relentless terror.

apps.name: Imperium
apps.short_description: Imperium is a single-player 4X space strategy game. Colonize alien worlds, design your own spaceships, research exotic technologies, and outmaneuver rival empires through diplomacy or open war. Build a galactic empire and rule it your way.

apps.name: Imprinted
apps.short_description: An audio restoration job becomes an investigation into the occult, as an elusive musician’s damaged cassette tapes are exhumed in northern Italy. Use a fully-operational desktop to sift through files, descending into the artist’s world in this slow-burning ghost tale of creativity and obsession.

apps.name: Infinicity
apps.short_description: In a moddable procedurally generated open world, humanity’s reign is crumbling. Once subservient machines have awakened, uniting in rebellion against their creators. As the android uprising spreads cities fall...

apps.name: Inn-Poster
apps.short_description: Embrace a fully randomised story with Inn-Poster! A fantasy story-driven murder mystery game set within an inn during the Renaissance. Assume the position of an undercover detective tasked with creating potions and gathering clues to the identity of a serial killer terrorising the local town!

apps.name: Insanitorium - Don't Be Afraid
apps.short_description: Trapped in a psychiatric hospital, you must escape demons lurking in the shadows.Explore Insanitorium only with your flashlight and scarce batteries, defend yourself with a machete and a dart gun, and face the strange patients. Remember, do not listen to the mannequins that whisper inside your head.

apps.name: Isolation Instinct: Farming, Craft, Survival
apps.short_description: Survive, build, and grow your own life in Isolation Instinct: Farming, Craft, Survival. Explore dangerous wilderness, gather resources, farm, craft equipment, and create a safe haven deep in the wild.

apps.name: JAILPOT
apps.short_description: Inmate 4417. Forty years. Nobody here has ever been released. In here money is cigarettes: scratch, roll, spin and bet your way across nine prison gambling tables, pay every boss his cut before roll call, keep your family's rent paid, and gamble your way out.

apps.name: Joker's Last Call
apps.short_description: Korea's One Card, reborn as a dark casino roguelike. Face two rivals at once, stack attacks and push the chain around the table, reverse it with a single Joker — and each battle, slip one trick card from your sleeve. Relics bend the rules. Tricks break them.

apps.name: KalshwK
apps.short_description: Get aboard the Ghost Train and fight with 99 lives worth of hardship to forge your own destiny with the unnatural grasp of KalshwK Desert : Top-Down 2d Roguelite Shooter

apps.name: Kamiyo
apps.short_description: A dystopian visual novel about Gods, humans and the 'Godkillers'. Pray to your God, and death to the Godkillers.

apps.name: Kandallo
apps.short_description: A short claymation horror game about feeding a strange fireplace.

apps.name: KEMURI
apps.short_description:
KEMURI is a Yokai-Possession Action Adventure set in KEMURI CITY, where the everyday and paranormal cross paths.
Explore as a Yokai Hunter, uncover the unseen with the FOXWINDOW, and wear their powers.
Run the streets, race across walls, and cut through the air to dive into the supernatural!

apps.name: Kingdom of Hope
apps.short_description: Rise from nine years of tyranny to rebuild a scarred medieval land. As a celebrated hero, you’re granted a farmstead by the new King. Forge a fresh life of growth, craft, and community.

apps.name: Kiwi
apps.short_description: Triple-jump, air dash, plant your beak on walls, leap off and more in this 3D collectathon platformer about a flightless bird that gets everywhere anyway. You crashed on tiny open-world islands, and you have places to be. Find secrets, Meet the locals, fix your plane and F off home (F is for Fly).

apps.name: KleptoMagia
apps.short_description: KleptoMagia is a unique real-time deckbuilder with no turns. Prepare your deck, react to enemy attacks, and play every card at the perfect moment.

apps.name: Knockout Kiss💋
apps.short_description: Five women have gone missing across a neon-lit city. Fight your way through 15 missions with dead-simple one-button combat: tap to strike, hold to charge, release. Every victory brings her closer and unlocks uncensored reward scenes. 18+ only.

apps.name: Knuckle Paradise
apps.short_description: A pixel-powered, combo-packed character action game starring Jane (a retired boxer) and her sidekick, Cocotte (a warrior… chicken?). Fight everybody. Learn combos from a pirate seagull. Fight harder. Level up your chicken. Find your kidnappers. Teach them a lesson.

apps.name: Koshmar: The Last Reverie
apps.short_description: When a city falls to a sleeping plague, nightmares rise up. Awaken the city as a mortician’s daughter who walks the line between the sleeping and the waking. Fight through the dreams, seal the rifts, make choices that chip away at who she is, try to become the nightmare that nightmares fear.

apps.name: Kyoryu
apps.short_description: You are a young, genetically modified, son of a samurai T-Rex in a post-apocalyptic Tokyo, who is fascinated by the once mighty humans and the ruins of their civilization.

apps.name: Laboratorio de Videojuegos
apps.short_description: Play, create, and share 3D platformer levels while discovering the secrets of video game design. Learn by creating, overcome challenges, and become the designer of your own adventures.

apps.name: Last Star Standing
apps.short_description: The aliens have weaponized the asteroids, and the stars are going dark. You are the last star standing. Pull worlds into orbit, forge them into planets that fight for you, and grow into a whole solar system to defeat the armada. A space bullet heaven.

apps.name: Laws of Nadragia
apps.short_description: Become a prosecutor in the totalitarian Nadragia. Convict criminals: use the laws and facts of court cases to get a verdict at any cost... But can you keep your conscience?

apps.name: LEGO® Skylines
apps.short_description: Build what only you can in LEGO® Skylines. In this cozy, customizable city-builder, your choices bring a living, breathing metropolis to life. Go big or obsess over the details. No instructions. Unlimited space. And there’s just one rule. Make it yours.

apps.name: Lich Lords
apps.short_description: A Lovecraftian roguelite where you wake up as a Lich with no memory, trapped in a world where everything wants to kill you. Forge deadly builds, slay rival Liches and monstrous horrors, and uncover the truth behind this strange new world.

apps.name: Life & Shadow: Celestial Call
apps.short_description:
You are trapped in the observatory of a star-obsessed professor atop Mount Clearveil.
Plan your survival during the day, confront the darkness of the basement at night.
Can you break the ritual and uncover the mystery?

apps.name: LIMIT ZERO BREAKERS
apps.short_description:
Explore the floating islands of Seraphia as a Breaker in this anime action RPG.
Build a team of characters with different fighting styles and unleash stylish attacks as you battle through ancient dungeons and massive monsters in search of the Archive of the Gods.

apps.name: LINER/TRACER
apps.short_description: LINER/TRACER is a stylish 2D action game where you fight using both your mouse and keyboard. Master fast, fluid mouse-controlled movement, evasive maneuvers, and attacks to defeat your enemies.

apps.name: Link Loop
apps.short_description:
Link Loop is a 2D puzzle platformer built around portals and satisfying physics.
Use portals to move objects, redirect lasers, and transport fluids. Levels have multiple solutions, and creativity is key.

apps.name: Little Desk Farm
apps.short_description: Run a pixel farm on your desktop. Grow crops, hire farmers, raise chickens and arrange buildings your way. Assign farmers to sow, water and harvest, then sell crops to expand your land. Check in on the farm now and then while you work, study or take a break.

apps.name: Little Warrior
apps.short_description: Little Warrior is a cute pixel-art twin-stick action roguelite. Choose staff, greatsword, bow, sword & shield, or dual blades. Build skills on a 6-slot grid, then play as a Gardener, Lumberjack, or Chef. Gear rarity and stat rerolls shape each run. Victory depends on your choices.

apps.name: Livin' the Cream: Ice Cream Simulator
apps.short_description: Run your own ice cream shop in a vibrant Caribbean setting! Prepare ice cream, mix flavors, add toppings, serve customers, keep your shop clean, restock ingredients, hire staff, and expand your shop from a small stand into a busy business.

apps.name: Lofelia's Cozy Corner
apps.short_description:
Meet Lofelia, your dreamy desktop companion who writes books as you work, study or game. In this cozy clicker game, every time you press a key Lofelia continues to write her stories.

How will you decorate Lofelia's Cozy Corner?

apps.name: Lost Hellden
apps.short_description: Resist your Sin. Reclaim your fate. Lost Hellden is an action JRPG from a team of genre veterans, featuring a gorgeous hand-painted 3D art style, a vast world to explore, and a unique phased battle system that blends turn-based and real-time combat.

apps.name: Lost Jelly
apps.short_description:
An arcade adventure with a new twist!

🚀 The alien robot Nimble must gather all the runaway Jelly after a crash landing. But there's a catch — his brakes are broken! Every move must be carefully planned, because once Nimble starts going, he won’t stop.

apps.name: Lost Legions
apps.short_description: Survive the aftermath of the historic Battle of the Teutoburg Forest in this story-driven open-world Roman survival game, with mythological elements. Build camps, free lost legionaries to fight by your side, defend against tribal raids, and explore an ancient Germanic world alone or with friends.

apps.name: Lotyas
apps.short_description: Experience single-player or multiplayer battles in Lotyas, a turn-based tactical strategy game with a medieval theme.

apps.name: Love Locks
apps.short_description: Love is forever. Until you bring bolt cutters. Remove 100,000 love locks solo or near friends in this relaxing cleanup game. Fish for keys with a magnet in the Seine in Paris, unlock tools from lockpicks to lasers, and turn romantic gestures into scrap metal 🔐

apps.name: Luckforge
apps.short_description: The House always wins. Unless the whole table cheats. Luckforge is a co-op casino auto-battler for 1-4 players, online or on one couch. Spin a cursed slot machine for recruits, merge them into monsters, and yank the lever mid-fight. What could possibly go wrong?

apps.name: Lust Shelter
apps.short_description: Apocalypse survival meets incremental adventure. By day, scavenge the wasteland and fight mutated beasts. By night, return to your shelter and have some fun with the girls. The world outside is brutal, but your shelter is pure bliss.

apps.name: LYSSA: Goddess of Rage
apps.short_description: A tactical PvP card RPG in a world run by mercenaries. Climb the rankings in short, brutal real-time battles, recruit legendary fighters, and build a deck around your Commander. Seize territory with your alliance and get to know your crew off the battlefield.

apps.name: Lysward
apps.short_description: Lysward is a single-player survival game set in a vast and unforgiving desert in the fantastical world of Umbra. Explore, craft, team up with your companion, and leverage the Amri magic to endure the heat.

apps.name: Macromancer
apps.short_description: Macromancer is a programming RPG sandbox where anything can be automated with the power of Python. Live out the fantasy of botting in an online RPG, playing alongside your many, many friends (assuming python scripts count as friends).

apps.name: Maiden Legion
apps.short_description: In this world, rotate and clear energy blocks to summon members of the Maiden Legion and fight alongside them. Rescue your captured companions, unlock their unique abilities, and protect the city together. Level up to unlock intimate, unabashed daily life moments with the girls.

apps.name: Master Thief Simulator
apps.short_description: Master Thief Simulator is a stealth-focused crime simulator where every move counts. Plan heists, sneak past security, pick locks, steal valuables, and vanish without a trace. Rise from petty theft to high-risk break-ins and become a true master thief.

apps.name: Maximum Apocalypse
apps.short_description: Scavenge, battle, survive! Choose your survivor and face diverse apocalyptic scenarios in this cooperative digital adaptation of the hit board game Maximum Apocalypse. Grab your friends or make new ones with 1-6 player apocalyptic roguelike gameplay.

apps.name: Mayhem TV
apps.short_description: Lights. Camera. CARNAGE!🩸 Welcome to MAYHEM TV, where the audience wants blood and the Producer wants ratings. Blast through hordes of maniacs, unleash ridiculous weapons, trigger insane studio disasters, crank up the HYPE and survive 11 monstrous bosses. THE SHOW MUST GO ON. YOU MIGHT NOT!

apps.name: Mayhem À La Carte
apps.short_description: Cook, fight, and serve under pressure in this chaotic 4-player co-op first-person cooking shooter. Prepare delicious meals, defend your kitchen from relentless enemies, and keep the orders flowing before everything falls apart.

apps.name: Mayhematic
apps.short_description: Mayhematic is a bullet heaven where the next door is always worth the trouble behind it. Blast through cartoon hordes solo or in 4-player online co-op, spend your kills on doors that go deeper, build something ridiculous and put your name on the leaderboard.

apps.name: MAZZIOSI
apps.short_description: MAZZIOSI is a single-player tactical card game about an unlikely crew reclaiming a crooked city. Recruit heroes, form three-person squads and fight turn-based battles. Follow the story or take on roguelike runs with branching routes, changing enemies and new upgrades.

apps.name: Meal Quest
apps.short_description: Explore the magical world inside your fridge, plan meals, and fight your way to the Dream City. Your in-game nutrition choices grant you combat bonuses that reflect each vitamin’s actual role in the body.

apps.name: Meowsweeper
apps.short_description: Welcome to Meowsweeper. As an orange cat on the clock, flip cards to catch mice across from your black cat boss. Caught mice snitch on Mean Dogs—every board can be deduced, no guessing. Chain laser pointers and catnip to bank 999 Mouse Chips in 12 shifts and buy the Golden Can.

apps.name: Mercy Incore
apps.short_description:
Solo indie character-action. You are a medieval knight in a techno-dimension.
Become a jet-boosted vampire to survive. Follow a full-metal spaniel to escape

apps.name: Momoawase
apps.short_description: A memory game with strange rules my 3-year-old daughter decided on all by herself. Match pairs of "も" (mo), spell out hidden animals in Japanese for big combos, and relax in quick solo rounds♪

apps.name: Monstarium
apps.short_description: Tiny pixel monsters live along the bottom of your screen, and climb on top of your windows. Hatch eggs, merge twins to evolve them, and collect over 1,000 looks across 95 forms while you work. Pet them, toss them a treat, and watch them make friends.

apps.name: Moon Sweepers
apps.short_description: An entire Moon to clean. One toothbrush to start. Team up with up to 16 players, collect and sell lunar dust, upgrade your tools, and unlock cleaning vehicles. Turn a ridiculous job into a thriving operation, if your friends actually help.

apps.name: Morgue Rot : The Coroner's Quest
apps.short_description: Inspired from the METAL Magazine! The Coroner's Quest is a horror RPG influenced by metal for metal-heads! Play as the coroner and uncover some gruesome events which lead you on a path to putting a stop to the ultimate evil and saving the town of St. Anne. If you can stop the MORGUE ROT!!

apps.name: Motel Owner Simulator
apps.short_description: Build and manage your own motel in Motel Owner Simulator. Design rooms, attract guests, expand your property, and grow from a small roadside stop into a thriving hospitality empire.

apps.name: Motocross The Game
apps.short_description: A hyper-realistic motocross simulator built by riders, for riders. Control bike and rider as two separate physics bodies, race online through matchmaking or private lobbies, and chase the clock on live global time-attack leaderboards. Assists let newcomers learn at their own pace.

apps.name: Murals
apps.short_description: These are not the tales you were told. Express yourself through stylized combat in the hand-painted worlds of Murals, a twisted isometric action-adventure where fairytales have gone spectacularly wrong.

apps.name: Music Manager
apps.short_description: Sign artists, develop talent, release music and steer careers through tours, festivals and changing trends in a detailed music industry management sim set from 1952 to 2026.

apps.name: MVX: London
apps.short_description: Save London in a shared-world co-op shooter set in a 1:1 recreation of the city. Battle creatures with real-world weapons and mysterious Flux powers.

apps.name: My Cannibal Family
apps.short_description: You are the lurking terror in My Cannibal Family, a gloriously grotesque monster horror sim. Build a twisted theme park, then use traps and stealthy attacks to harvest guests within a deadly sandbox of your own creation!

apps.name: My Own Roguelike: RPG
apps.short_description: An auto-attack roguelite RPG. Pick level-up cards every run, farm gear with random options and grow a 331-node passive tree to craft a build that is all your own — across 9 worlds, Hell difficulty and an endless boss tower.

apps.name: My Penguin Friend
apps.short_description: Washed up thousands of miles from home, Dindim, a little penguin on a big journey must puzzle across an unfamiliar, tropical coastline, and forge an unlikely friendship to find more than just his way home.

apps.name: My Summer Project Together
apps.short_description: Build your first car from scratch in a cheerful summer adventure, solo or with up to 4 players online. Earn money from odd jobs, explore the countryside for hidden parts, buy supplies, assemble every system, and enjoy the freedom and chaos of summer with friends.

apps.name: NAND²
apps.short_description: Build a computer from a single NAND gate, together: online co-op for up to 4 players on one board. Wire relays into logic, memory and a 16-bit CPU with a pipeline and a cache, then program it. Robots in mazes, Nim, even a shooter on your own CPU. Level editor and Steam Workshop.

apps.name: National Park Tycoon
apps.short_description: Bring your national park to life! Balance nature preservation with visitor enjoyment as you build peaceful trails, cozy campsites, fun activities and more. Rise through the ranger ranks, collect badges, and watch your parks grow into places you’re proud to call your own in this 2D simulation game.

apps.name: Nekome: Nazi Hunter
apps.short_description: Hunt and kill Nazis in a stealthy single-player campaign with bloody and brutal melee combat. Study your enemies, confirm your approach, and become an unexpected assassin fueled by violent revenge.

apps.name: Never Alone 2
apps.short_description: Discover a world of fierce, frozen beauty in Never Alone 2, sequel to the BAFTA-winning adventure game created in the Inupiaq storytelling tradition. Explore the Arctic as Nuna and Fox, unearthing an epic mystery threatening your community in this new 3D, co-op adventure.

apps.name: NEXO GAME
apps.short_description: NEXO GAME is an online social game for adults. Create your character, explore realistic worlds, and meet other players. Customize your look, spend time with friends, and share the moments that make you want to meet again.

apps.name: Night Crew
apps.short_description: A lo-fi mall with high-key problems. Foul creatures roam the halls - and management still expects YOU to mop the floor. Even though the floor ate Gary. Welcome to the Night Crew. You are 𝙙𝙚𝙛𝙞𝙣𝙞𝙩𝙚𝙡𝙮 not paid enough for this.

apps.name: Night Gig
apps.short_description: The boss needs the product shipped before the deadline and hires people for the night shift at high pay. At your workstation you handle post reviews, file sorting and audio repair; meanwhile the office lights dim, devices cut out, and a ghost closes in on sound and sight. Finish the night's work — and avoid the anomalies.

apps.name: Night Machine
apps.short_description: We’ve just learned the Moon is a giant alien doomsday factory, which is kind of a bummer. You've been chosen to operate a spaceship into the core and destroy it for us. Think fast, adapt under pressure, and deploy powerful combinations as you fight your way through in this real-time card battler.

apps.name: Night Plane
apps.short_description: Night Plane is a job-sim horror game where you work as a flight attendant on a doomed plane. Check tickets, serve passengers, and decide who stays onboard as demons hide among innocent souls. Naturally, management says it’s your problem.

apps.name: Nighthold
apps.short_description: Sandbox survival RPG where days are for preparation and nights are for survival. Gather resources, build and fortify your shelter, fight the Rot and raiders - solo or with friends in online co-op.

apps.name: Nightholme
apps.short_description:
Team up or strike out alone to hunt an eldritch Gloomfiend in a city crawling with horrors. 
Channel corruption and transform into a monstrous Grimspawn for devastating bursts of power. But beware. Madness is patient, and you look delicious.
Survive the run. Take the prize. No one leaves unchanged.

apps.name: No Body No Problem!
apps.short_description: One of you is the cop. The rest are panicked suspects. Hide the body, clean up the evidence, don’t rat each other out, and get rid of everything before your cop friend knocks on the door. There is only one rule: if the body is found, you’re all done for.

apps.name: NO EXIT
apps.short_description: A survival horror FPS where you face hordes of zombies, explore abandoned environments, gather resources, and fight to survive.

apps.name: No Murders in Grimwick
apps.short_description: Investigate a murder at Grimwick’s harvest festival in this hand-drawn point-and-click mystery. Question suspicious locals, collect clues, use items, and uncover the truth behind a town that insists there was no murder.

apps.name: No Road Home
apps.short_description: Post-Apocalyptic Open World Survival. The bombs fell. The world didn't survive — but some people did. Now mutants haunt the ruins and raiders rule what's left. You have a car, a few bullets, and one mission: bring the survivors back together.

apps.name: NO SUCH MONSTERS
apps.short_description: A boy, a flashlight, and a house that no longer feels like home. No Such Monsters is a side-scrolling horror adventure. Explore dark rooms, tunnels, and a ruined chapel, solve environmental puzzles, and outrun the creatures that find you.

apps.name: NOROI SHOPPING
apps.short_description: You are shopping on a major online store when strange listings gradually begin to appear. The more you look into them, the more clearly the whole picture of a crime comes into view…

apps.name: NOTAIM
apps.short_description: Fight for the corner office in this chaotic fast-paced multiplayer office shooter. Random weapons, brutal close-quarters combat, and no second chances. Climb the corporate ladder the only way that matters: violence.

apps.name: Novalex Project Zero
apps.short_description: A turn-based car-company tycoon. Design every model from the chassis up, run the factories, undercut on price, and out-engineer a field that grows to 30 AI rivals across a century of motoring. Build the carmaker that lasts, or go bankrupt trying.

apps.name: Nudus
apps.short_description: Welcome to Nudus — an adult merge strategy game where real-time arena battles, tactical deck building, and seductive 18+ rewards come together.

apps.name: Office Party
apps.short_description: Office Party is a fully 3D edgy comedy adventure game inspired by classic comedies of the '90s, and also the long awaited sequel to House Party.  Dive into the craziness and debauchery with all new characters, game mechanics and locations, and maybe a visit from some old party friends.

apps.name: Olympus Rangers
apps.short_description:
Welcome to the ultimate battle simulator where you can create, manage and face dozens of opponents in multiple battle modes. Can you become the champion? Throw away your fainted teammates? How about becoming the world's best in online play? Take on the Olympus!
Can you become the very best?

apps.name: One Maze
apps.short_description: Type fast. Build your abilities. Destroy endless waves of words in a chaotic roguelike typing survival game.

apps.name: One More Plate
apps.short_description: Feed your fellow Shape Buddies to a bizarre cast of Glutton Monsters before they put you on the menu. Catch, balance and fling food with absurd, anything-but-proper plates — solo, or 2 players on one PC or via Steam Remote Play Together. Everything obeys physics; nothing obeys you.

apps.name: One More Tower
apps.short_description: One More Tower is a horde survival TD set in a medieval fantasy world. Pioneer an unexplored forest, build your town and defenses, and hold out against the onslaught of enemies. How long can you survive?

apps.name: One Must Rule
apps.short_description: An empire-building auto-battler set in a harsh medieval settlement where every strategic command shapes your kingdom’s fate. Build your empire from the council table, discover game-breaking card synergies, and battle against rival players. Every choice counts, only one will rule!

apps.name: Only Axolotls
apps.short_description: Collect, breed, and care for adorable axolotls in a cozy 2D aquarium, manage your resources, discover new abilities, and build your team to take on turn-based battles.

apps.name: Only Fans
apps.short_description: <Only Fans> is an object finding game where you find mildly boobs and mildly butts objects in a gooning rehab full of fans.

apps.name: Only Fog Remains
apps.short_description: She came in search of a ghost story to record, but is now part of it. With only a cassette player in hand, Cynthia must now traverse the fog and search for her friends before it changes them forever.

apps.name: ORAE
apps.short_description: Explore a dense, interconnected world once inhabited by humans and souls. Find your path, solve puzzles, collect floppy disks and make friends to uncover this world's deepest secrets.

apps.name: ORTHEVYR
apps.short_description: ORTHEVYR is a dark fantasy third-person action RPG. Journey as a lone traveler through dangerous lands, master fast-paced combat, wield weapons and magic, customize your equipment, and face deadly creatures and formidable bosses.

apps.name: Otherside Tapes: Favela
apps.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game with a found-footage aesthetic. In search of the mysterious Street 7, an urban explorer finds himself trapped in a loop of distorted realities, rituals, and a supernatural presence that controls the Favela das Almas.

apps.name: Ounba
apps.short_description: Ounba is a 3D arcade action game where you pilot a high-speed spaceship inside a huge futuristic tube. Dodge obstacles, fight enemies, shoot, collect resources, and try to beat your best score and the scores of other players! 🚀

apps.name: Outscratched
apps.short_description: Outscratched is a scratchcard roguelike deckbuilder. Assemble your deck from a multitude of powerful cards, collect blessed charms to influence your luck, and discover endless exciting combos to beat the odds against a diabolical lottery.

apps.name: Outward 2
apps.short_description: Outward 2 is a challenging action RPG with survival elements, focusing around a grounded experience. There’s no hand-holding, no scaled encounters, no divine blessings to make you tower over your enemies. Eat your meal, check your map, grab your backpack: an unforgiving, rewarding adventure awaits.

apps.name: Paladin HC
apps.short_description: Command a 3D Paladin self-propelled howitzer in scenarios based on real military operations. Calculate firing range, adjust your tactical position, manage resources, and support your allies. Love military games? Add Paladin HC to your Steam wishlist and support our indie team!

apps.name: Pale Tide
apps.short_description:
A top-down zombie extraction survival game where you and your dog scavenge resources from deadly infected zones. 
Rescue survivors, and return to a hidden bunker to upgrade your gear, grow your crew, and prepare your escape before the largest horde ever witnessed floods the region, the Pale Tide.

apps.name: Palehollow Hospital | 灰谷医院
apps.short_description: This is a first-person indie horror game. You play as a video blogger exploring an abandoned hospital, uncovering the dark secrets hidden within its walls.

apps.name: PAO PAO
apps.short_description: Welcome to PAO PAO! Discover a cozy seaside town full of little joys! Play solo or in co-op with up to three friends. Cook delicious meals, go fishing, grow crops, and create a home of your own by the sea.

apps.name: Papaya Plaza
apps.short_description: Welcome to your new life as mayor of a tourist town in this small slice of life town building game. Restore the community, meet adorable villagers, and create your dream escape at your own pace. What will you build today? Peep peep!

apps.name: Paraxima
apps.short_description: Welcome to E.S.C. As a team of 1-3, your job is to respond to paranormal outbreaks of The Static. Investigate either as a Field Agent or an Operator. Establish the chain of events with evidence to identify the Entity. Follow the protocol to seal it.

apps.name: Past Visiting Hours
apps.short_description: Past Visiting Hours is a 1v3 asymmetrical multiplayer horror game. Diagnose cursed patients, survive the hospital's monstrous inhabitants, or take control as The Board and turn the hospital into a living nightmare. Your shift is about to get a whole lot worse.

apps.name: PASTDARK
apps.short_description: PASTDARK is a horror extraction game with CO-OP up to 4 players with a twist - MADNESS! This makes each of the players see and hear things which are not there. Extract toys and submarine parts by utilizing stealth, teamwork, proximity voice chat and various items before the madness overwhelms you!

apps.name: Path of Damned
