apps.short_description: A roguelike where combat is a slot machine you build yourself. Weapons, shields, and potions are reel symbols: every spin hits, heals, and grants armor. Pack your bag, spend souls on talents, and hunt the Source on a cursed island.

apps.name: Pathbreakers: Roaming Blades
apps.short_description: Pathbreakers: Roaming Blades is a turn-based tactical RPG where you lead a company of mercenaries in a medieval fantasy world. Try your hand at mercenary work, trading, or exploring, and keep your crew well stocked for brutal combat in a procedurally-generated open-world campaign.

apps.name: Paw Works Co.
apps.short_description: Run your repair shop in a cosy animal neighborhood. Diagnose and repair your customers' broken belongings, and organize your workshop your way. Grow your shop, unlock upgrades like delivery, and manage it all from your computer.

apps.name: Pawnbroke
apps.short_description: A darkly funny pawnshop roguelike. Your late uncle left you his shop and his debt to Mr. Grin. Buy strange stock, arrange the shelf so every item boosts its neighbours, and pay up every five days. Come up short and he takes a finger.

apps.name: PAYDAY: Aces High
apps.short_description:
Nothing hits like the moment the mask comes on. Plan bold jobs, pull off stylish chaos, and take down a business titan - one explosive score at a time. High stakes, big money, no mercy: PAYDAY: Aces High is the definitive VR co-op heist game for up to 4 players.

Revenge has never felt so good.

apps.name: Peagle XP
apps.short_description:
A pachinko roguelite where eagles shoot their own eggs. They smash pegs, chain combos, buy passives at the shop, and grab overpowered power-ups to conquer each world.

Eagles love to play. Too bad for their offspring.
Eagles love to play. Too bad for their offspring.

apps.name: Pecking Order
apps.short_description: Pecking Order is a 16-player online physics-based party game where you eat your friends.

apps.name: PETAFAB: Bot Invasion
apps.short_description: PETAFAB: Bot Invasion is a single-player first-person shooter with fully destructible environments and large-scale physics simulation. Blast through massive swarms of AI-controlled bots and take down huge bosses. Collateral damage is just a bonus.

apps.name: Phantom Hellcat
apps.short_description: Phantom Hellcat is a dynamic slasher-platformer with showy combos in a theatrical setting. When demons kidnap Jolene’s mother, the young woman must take the stage and save her—but in the world of plays and props, things are not always what they appear to be.

apps.name: Phroller
apps.short_description: The next generation touchscreen native, controller tested, battery efficient, cross-platform with tablets and mobile, offline enabled, 2.5/3D VTT, Dice Roller and RPG Companion! Featuring a massive library of free assets and models.

apps.name: PHUY
apps.short_description: You’re a crew of hapless thieves with one job: rob a museum and make it out alive. Hunt for valuables, solve puzzles, and survive the locals. Just try not to become part of the exhibit. A co-op horror game for 1–4 players.

apps.name: Pinball Hero
apps.short_description: Pinball Hero is a turn-based roguelike RPG on an arcade cabinet. Everything is a marble — heroes, skills, talents, all marbles colliding with each other. Piece them together into your build.

apps.name: Pipkind
apps.short_description: Pop matching dice, collect playful outfits and help 100 quirky friends in a colorful retro puzzle adventure. Explore a growing village, tackle 1,000 campaign levels, or chase your best score in an ever-faster Marathon. Think fast: wrong shots stack up!

apps.name: Pirates Republic
apps.short_description: Build your pirate republic from nothing. Survive, cook, trade, and plunder your way through a procedurally generated Caribbean in this open-world survival sandbox. No fantasy - just history, grit, and freedom. Play solo or with friends in co-op.

apps.name: PISO 6
apps.short_description: PISO 6 is a first-person psychological horror game with a low-poly aesthetic. After his father’s death, Tomás returns to the apartment where he grew up. What seemed like a simple search for a will turns into a nightmare that pulls him back into the past.

apps.name: PIX Football Manager
apps.short_description: An online football manager. Scout talent from 350+ clubs, trust your eye to find the right players, and outbid rival managers in auctions. Build squad chemistry, shape your tactics, and face other managers’ clubs in weekly leagues, on your own schedule.

apps.name: Pixel Gun 2
apps.short_description: Fast-paced multiplayer shooter with destructible arenas, wild builds, and matches that never play the same. Break the map, adapt on the fly, and outplay your opponents in short, chaotic PvP battles.

apps.name: Planted!
apps.short_description: Sow. Grow. Throw. Planted! is a chaotic 1-4 player combat game where gardens are arenas, plants are weapons, and grudges are settled one harvest at a time.

apps.name: Plastic Lust 2
apps.short_description: An erotic visual novel about doll girls who swap out their parts for futanari fun. Enjoy raunchy play with gorgeous dolls as Dane starts to build his harem. Featuring art by Modeseven!

apps.name: Plucked
apps.short_description: Up to 12 players, one pond. A top-down bullet-heaven roguelite where you merge your guns into increasingly stupid firepower, then find out how much of it one duck can hold. Survive the waves, outlive the swarm, quack responsibly.

apps.name: Plumber Simulator
apps.short_description: Become a plumber and restore water flow in suburban homes. Unclog toilets, replace sink traps, renovate bathrooms - the residents can only count on you during an emergency.

apps.name: Plunder Bay
apps.short_description: An online pirate board game for 2–6 players. Sail scattered islands, blast rivals with cannons and rockets, and STEAL their treasure when you sink them. Spin the helm, claim islands, and win wild minigames — first to 4 treasures wins. Grab your crew and plunder the bay!

apps.name: Police Activity: Cardboardman
apps.short_description: Police Activity: Cardboardman is a first-person slasher game where, in one segment, you play as a serial killer nicknamed "Cardboardman," and in the other, as a detective trying to catch him.

apps.name: Pop Pop Arena
apps.short_description: Aim carefully. Blame your friends. Pop Pop Arena is an online physics party game for up to 8 players. Choose your direction and power, launch together, and send rivals flying. Be the last Pop standing in Knockout or race to the finish in Marathon.

apps.name: Pop! Jelly PangPang
apps.short_description: Trap rivals with jelly bombs — pang-pang! A 50-stage adventure through ten candy worlds against the Sugar Giant, online battles for up to 6, two players on one PC, and a map maker to build your own arenas.

apps.name: Port Logistics Simulator: Dockside Harbor Handling
apps.short_description: Manage heavy machinery, load cargo, operate cranes and tugboats, and keep the harbor running smoothly in Port Logistics Simulator: Dockside Harbor Handling. Experience realistic port operations across dynamic day and night conditions ⚓

apps.name: Portal 2: Community Edition
apps.short_description: Portal 2: Community Edition (P2:CE) is a community-maintained version of Portal 2 that significantly enhances the way you make and play content, offering new capabilities such as a brand-new scripting system, an improved Hammer map editor and significantly increased limits over the original game.

apps.name: Praxion-7
apps.short_description: A drowned world you can never leave. Crash on it, jack into alien tech, and make your living cutting open salvage, fitting ships and undercutting rivals on a market players run. 390 islands are still unclaimed. Take one.

apps.name: Priority One
apps.short_description:
Priority One is a game where you and your friends play as a SWAT team where you defuse bombs, rescue hostages, locate evidence and arrest or eliminate Hostiles
Also features a Alternative mode With Zombies ,objectives to search for and survivors to rescue
1-4 player Co-Op

apps.name: Prism Rules
apps.short_description: Prism Rules is a game where you use mirrors and prisms to bend light and solve puzzles.

apps.name: Project Angels 2
apps.short_description: The visual novel sequel to Project Angels. Steel Waters and Apollyon—two factions of the ANGELS have tormented the Indicus Ocean for years. Their maker, a Puppetmaster turned Savior, now aims to balance the two beliefs of liberty and stability, all while reuniting what was whole under a new home.

apps.name: Project Gears
apps.short_description: Charge! Smash! Don't stop! Survive! Race through chaotic city streets as Engine Heart and Motor Soul. Upgrade each hero's unique abilities, blast through enemies at top speed, and keep your engine running. If your power runs out, so do you.

apps.name: PROJECT LEVELS
apps.short_description: PROJECT LEVELS is a creative multiplayer sandbox where you and your friends can build worlds, create interactive experiences and bring your ideas to life together.

apps.name: Project Substrata
apps.short_description: Dig, build, connect—and watch your factory come to life. Shape the terrain, link mining and production lines, and manage power in a first-person base-building and automation game. Restoring a ruined planet is our long-term development goal.

apps.name: Projekt Melody: A Nut Between Worlds
apps.short_description: Experience the world's first and most ambitious NEXT GEN HENTAI GAME! With a bit of luck, above-average sexual skills, and a party of beautiful waifus and husbandos at your side, save the entire goddamn Cyberverse from a world-eating corruption in Projekt Melody: A Nut Between Worlds!

apps.name: PSYCHOFINGER
apps.short_description: PSYCHOFINGER – it's a game where pointing fingers isn't just rude... It's essential! Become an agent at the Department of Metaphysical Investigations, survive hordes of enemies, and upgrade your character.

apps.name: PUBG: DED.NET
apps.short_description: PUBG:   is a multi-player FPS with roguelite elements set in 1990’s Cascadia.

apps.name: Puck'n Hell
apps.short_description: A dark arcade air hockey duel set in limbo. Strange opponents. No excuses. Just you and the puck. Easy to understand. Difficult to master. Welcome to Hell. Grab your paddle.

apps.name: Pup & Mole: Gold Rush
apps.short_description: Join Pup & Mole on a cozy mining adventure across 7 historical areas. Hop into your minecart, build rail tracks, and dig deeper for hidden artifacts. Upgrade your gear, unlock new tools, and complete your collection while earning money by selling gold and rare treasures.

apps.name: Quadrillion Carrots
apps.short_description: 🥕Harvest an absurd number of carrots! Start with your bare hands, unlock powerful tools and helper robots, explore six farming zones, catch living carrots, survive explosive ones, and turn manual labor into harvesting chaos. 🤖

apps.name: Racefoot Manager
apps.short_description: Take command of a racing team and build a dynasty. Negotiate driver and sponsor contracts, develop your car through R&D, plan tyre strategy through sun and rain, and chase championship glory across full, consequential seasons.

apps.name: RAD: Ascension
apps.short_description: Some runs you race the clock. Some you just flow. RAD is a movement game built around speed and experimentation. Pump, jump, swing and glide through neon courses, race leaderboard ghosts, shave milliseconds off every run, and play it all to your own music. Instant restarts; one more run, every time.

apps.name: Radioactive Roses
apps.short_description: Radioactive Roses is a deckbuilding, tactical RPG. Explore the wasteland, fight mutants, scavage for resources, and... met cute and horny ladies where most guys died, and you are one of the last surviving males!

apps.name: Raftcraft
apps.short_description: A 4-player co-op adventure where goblins build a fragile makeshift vessel, hunt for loot across dangerous lands, and use their Mage Hands to grab, swing, pull, and thoroughly inconvenience each other.

apps.name: Railborn
apps.short_description: Railborn is a survival game where you build your train piece by piece. Navigate a world entangled by branching tracks. Find rare plants to cultivate on your farms. Upgrade your train - manage its power systems, direct resource flow, and distribute water. Designed for 1 to 4 players.

apps.name: Railtown
apps.short_description: Every great city starts with a station. In Railtown, trains bring tourists and money while you grow a tiny town into a bustling city: build homes, shops and tram lines, upgrade your train from steam to high-speed, and keep your citizens happy through every season.

apps.name: Rat Game
apps.short_description: Asymmetrical horror comedy co-op for up to 8 players. Play either a pack of Rats trying to sabotage a restaurant, or the Chef determined to stop them.

apps.name: Re:Draw
apps.short_description: One day the Erasure happened. The world didn't die - it was simply erased. You're one of the few left holding a pencil. Restore the erased world from scratch: sketch, bring ecosystems to life, and watch as the settlers you drew build a civilization.

apps.name: Realm Nine
apps.short_description: On the land of Jiuzhou, there are fragments of your plundered Elf Wings hidden. You will play as five types of real-time shapeshifters and embark on a journey to find the lost fragments.

apps.name: Red Recon: 1944
apps.short_description: Red Recon is an isometric real-time tactics game with stealth elements, where you command a squad of Soviet scouts deployed into East Prussia in the autumn of 1944, on the eve of the Red Army’s strategic offensive. Be the first in the enemy’s lair!

apps.name: Red Rust Pioneers
apps.short_description: Build a new life in the Wild West open world of Red Rust Valley, alone or with up to 4 players in co-op. Hunt, farm, raise animals and craft through the changing seasons in this survival game as your camp grows from a canvas tent to a homestead. Free land, open skies, and a world worth exploring.

apps.name: Reforj
apps.short_description: Reclaim the future. Rewrite the past. Reforj the world.

apps.name: Relicbearer TD
apps.short_description: Build your defences, unleash devastating abilities, and claim powerful Relics in this 2D Tower Defence Strategy game.

apps.name: Rescue Drone Simulator: Second Chance
apps.short_description: Pilot drones into burning buildings, frozen landmarks, and collapsing tunnels. Rescue survivors, build and customize your fleet, and lead a team of specialists who never got a second chance - until now.

apps.name: Reshine
apps.short_description: Gently restore old objects by cleaning away layers of dust, rust, and time. Reshine is a minimalistic, relaxing experience: use a range of tools to watch years of grime disappear before your eyes. No management, no pressure - just you and the satisfaction of bringing vintage treasures back to life.

apps.name: Revenant Rangers
apps.short_description: Ride out as a Revenant Ranger—an undead lawman bound by Hell’s contract—to hunt the escaped souls of the damned. Gun down demons, witches, and sinners across the Hell Plains in a brutal, fast-paced third-person co-op shooter where death is only the beginning.

apps.name: Rhythm Doggo
apps.short_description:
You wanted to play a video game and just got transformed into a dog!
Rhythm Doggo is a classic platform adventure where you play as a dog and make music on the way. Can you go back to your human form?

apps.name: Rise of the Spellbaker
apps.short_description: In Rise of the Spellbaker, a charming hand-crafted, fairy-tale inspired Action-Adventure, one Witch finds herself to be the sole survivor of an unknown plague. With no-one but your loyal Cat Familiar by your side, set forth into the corrupted land.

apps.name: Risk it Little Biscuit
apps.short_description:
Risk it, little biscuit! 
Crunch through endless hordes of sugar-crazed sweets in this bite-sized bullet-heaven roguelite. Pick a hero from the pantry, stack absurd snack weapons, evolve them into pure kitchen chaos and topple crowned bosses, one crumbly run at a time.

apps.name: Rivals Hover League
apps.short_description:
'Rivals Hover League' is a vehicular arena combat game where players battle in arenas across the galaxy using hover vehicles with various abilities.
Join your teammates and show off your skills - hover, boost, shoot your way to become the MVP!

apps.name: Roads Taken
apps.short_description: A tactical role-playing game where every adventure is new: the story, the heroes, the world and its battlefields are drawn from a single seed. Lead your company through a land at war, forge bonds that change the fight, and live with the roads you take.

apps.name: Rockhounds
apps.short_description: Rockhounds is a 1-4 player extraction shooter where you and your squad brave the deadliest planets to extract minerals for ruthless Megacorps. Every mission is a fight for survival, wealth, and glory. Will you conquer the chaos and escape with your team? Gear up, and prove you’ve got what it takes!

apps.name: ROG Lite
apps.short_description: An isometric fantasy MMORPG of dungeon expeditions, open-world PvP and guild conquest. Master weapons and magic, explore deep dungeons with friends, build a home and fight for control of forts in a shared, persistent world.

apps.name: RollerCoaster Tycoon® Wonderworks
apps.short_description: It’s the grand opening of a new RollerCoaster Tycoon, featuring new levels of chaos and wonder as you do whatever it takes to keep guests happy (and injury-free). Customize rides, manage guests, and build wild roller coasters in your theme parks as you boost profits and expand your empire.

apps.name: Rollgeon
apps.short_description: Build your own collection of customizable dice and battle your way through the dungeon in this turn-based roguelike. Roll, reroll, and create powerful combos inspired by the classic dice game Generala. Enchant your dice, manipulate the odds, and discover new builds with every run.

apps.name: Rookie Raiders
apps.short_description: Rookies, raid the dungeons — claim your wealth and fame! Craft your own builds with a cast of one-of-a-kind characters and complete your party. Everything runs on your design. Rookie Raiders — the fully automated combat roguelite RPG!

apps.name: Runaway Rocket
apps.short_description: Your rocket blasts into the sky — but the monster could turn around at any moment! Time your landing, build up the target prize, and push your limits!

apps.name: Rushmark
apps.short_description: Your dash is your weapon. Miss, and you wait. Kill, and you get it back instantly. A cyberpunk speedrunning platformer built on one refundable dash: wall-kick, chain and strike through ten handmade courses in thirty-second runs, then race any rival's ghost off the leaderboard.

apps.name: S-Ranker
apps.short_description: Enter 5-minute dungeons, clear out monsters, choose your powers during battle, and rise from F-Rank to S-Rank in an action roguelite.

apps.name: S.E.X. Project: Simulated Emotional Xenotech
apps.short_description: S.E.X. Project is a first-person sci-fi adventure where you explore a futuristic facility and build relationships with female androids through dialogue and choices. Complete quests, uncover secrets and discover how your decisions lead to different storylines and endings.

apps.name: S.O.N.A.R. - Submarine Operators Not Actually Ready
apps.short_description: S.O.N.A.R. (Submarine Operators Not Actually Ready) is a 1–4 player co-op submarine sim where teamwork is essential, panic is inevitable, and sinking is always one wrong button away. Use sonar, pilot, fight, repair, and pray your friends know what to do.

apps.name: SandEEE
apps.short_description: Write code for an alternate universe in SandEEE, just keep in mind "EEE sees all".

apps.name: SAW: Genesis
apps.short_description: A century before Jigsaw, survival demanded sacrifice. Experience the thrilling world of SAW first-hand in a new 3v1 multi-player horror game where three Accused must work together to escape a maze of traps, while one Judge orchestrates their rehabilitation.

apps.name: SCP: Minor Case - FLP -
apps.short_description: A story-driven adventure game set in the SCP Foundation universe

apps.name: Seaworks: Trap Season
apps.short_description: Seaworks: Trap Season is a hands-on crab fishing life sim set in the remote pacific northwest in the 1990s. Take fishing bounties by fax, maintain and customize your boat, brave changing weather, sort your catch and build a small life on the edge of the sea.

apps.name: Send and Defend
apps.short_description: Send & Defend is a competitive multiplayer tower defense game. Carve your own maze, build towers and send creeps to grow your income. Watch your rivals, steal their lives and be the last one standing.

apps.name: Senior Survival Club
apps.short_description: In a zombie apocalypse, a grandmother takes a chainsaw to find her grandson. Defeat slow, persistent zombies, collect gear, and strengthen with exercise. Advance through ever-stronger hordes, reclaiming youthful power in this survival action game.

apps.name: Seres Universalis:Three Kingdoms
apps.short_description: Return to the Three Kingdoms period. On the grand strategic tactical battlefield, use terrain for defense setup and resource allocation to shift the battle situation. Control the war via hexagonal grid movement and tactical ability activation, and unify the realm.

apps.name: Sexception: Dark Seeds
apps.short_description: Enter unstable dreams, recover a missing past, and choose whether to respect or rewrite the desires of six women in this is erotic, choice-driven, psychological, adult visual novel.

apps.name: Sexhelgard: Shadow of Lust
apps.short_description: Enter Sexhelgard, a dark fantasy adult visual novel where you play a charming mercenary hunting a stolen magical artifact. Seduce powerful women, unravel an occult conspiracy, and discover how far desire can lead a hero.

apps.name: Shadows of Chroma Tower
apps.short_description: Choose your faction and fight for control of the Tower! Shadows of Chroma Tower mixes together the best features of Dungeon Crawlers and ARPGs. Choose between steel, wit and magic to face hordes of enemies and huge bosses in PvE dungeons while participating in Asynchronous PvP modes.

apps.name: Shahed Hunters
apps.short_description: Night raid on the city. Launch an interceptor drone from your own FPV radio or gamepad, man the anti-aircraft gun of a mobile fire team, run the air defense post — and keep the lights on. A realistic first-person air defense simulator against Shahed drones.

apps.name: Shameless Supreme
apps.short_description: Shameless Supreme is a story-rich pixel RPG with turn-based combat and dark humor. Explore crumbling worlds, build your party, and combine status effects for deadly reactions. Use optional mic-powered trash talk to weaken enemies and break their defenses. Survive, and find your way home.

apps.name: Shark Mart
apps.short_description: Shark Mart is a crazy co-op simulator about sharks undercover disguised as friendly dolphins. Run the shop, and scrub whales to secretly kidnap unsuspecting fish and cook up tasty delicacies! But beware - the Fish Police are out to expose your toothy secret...

apps.name: Shift Happens: Together
apps.short_description: Play solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players. Take warehouse orders, find the required parts, move goods, assemble and pack products, handle unexpected incidents, and deliver everything as quickly as possible to maximize your earnings.

apps.name: Ship Graveyard Simulator 3
apps.short_description: Welcome to the biggest ship graveyard in the world! Grab your hammer, start up the heavy machinery, and experience the ultimate shipbreaking. Explore a living town, hire workers to expand your ship graveyard in a completely new level of realism, scale, and freedom!

apps.name: shlack!
apps.short_description: Shlack! is a top-down roguelite where you play as an artist trapped inside their own magazine. Survive against your own characters and drawings.

apps.name: ShootyCraft
apps.short_description: Massive space battles with base building, crafting, automation, and destructible environments. Fight as a team or take on everyone in a free-for-all arena. Play online, single-player, or cooperative with friends.

apps.name: Shot Rock
apps.short_description: Shot Rock is a curling game where you call the shot, throw it, and sweep it home, presented like curling on TV. Two full teams take the ice in arenas and club venues. Play the AI, a friend, or players online.

apps.name: Silent Authority: Blood & Bourbon
apps.short_description: Strategy meets action RPG in the 1920s New York criminal underworld. Build your empire through front businesses and bootlegging, lead your crew in brutal top-down tactical combat, and rule the city through cunning diplomacy or pure bloodshed.

apps.name: Sincognito
apps.short_description: A social deduction investigation horror game where one of you is secretly possessed by a Deadly Sin. Use stealth and proximity chat to cooperate or deceive as you gather clues and compare findings to deduce which Sin is haunting the castle.

apps.name: Sivers
apps.short_description: Sivers is an RPG-roguelike with a unique style, where waves of enemies test your strategy. Use spells and build defenses, develop your hero, and fight bosses and varied foes. Victory on the first try is unlikely — every attempt brings you closer to success!

apps.name: Sky Pirates
apps.short_description: Set sail with your friends aboard a flying pirate ship! Explore mysterious islands, plunder ships and treasures, and amass a fortune… But beware: the richer you get, the more you attract unwanted attention!

apps.name: Slidegame
apps.short_description: Slide through strange megastructures with incredible speed.

apps.name: SLOP
apps.short_description: SLOP is a Co-op Comedy Horror Cooking game where 4 chefs cook the BIGGEST, SLOPPIEST meal possible to keep the Grubshaft running and reach the Final floor before you become SLOP

apps.name: Slot Crawler
apps.short_description: Explore. Kill. Loot. Die. Feed your hard-earned tokens to a slot machine with questionable intentions, then unlock new ways to make terrible decisions on the next run. Slot Crawler is a top-down action roguelike with procedural maps, chaotic builds, and combinations that definitely should not work.

apps.name: SNF Breakdown
apps.short_description: An online multiplayer game for 1-6 players. Run a chaotic alien nursing home with your friends, care for unhinged residents, and sabotage your coworkers with a vast arsenal of weapons, traps, and chaos fruits. Whoever has the most points at the end of the shift wins.

apps.name: Social Space
apps.short_description: Social Space is the ultimate sandbox for creating and playing together. Whether you're here to discover something new or bring your own ideas to life, Social Space offers a welcoming environment for everyone!

apps.name: SOKO 1977: Anti-Terror Task Force
apps.short_description: Take command of a special police task force in 1970s Germany. Uncover terrorist networks, coordinate operations, and make far-reaching decisions. Experience an intense, historically inspired scenario that explores the balance between security, freedom, and the rule of law.

apps.name: Sokobomb
apps.short_description: Sokobomb is a puzzle game about blowing things up to find your way forward.

apps.name: Sol Protocol
apps.short_description: Sol Protocol is a dynamic VR Co-Op roguelike where you team up and physically pilot a spaceship through dangerous, procedurally generated stellar systems. Manage your spaceship, man the turrets, explore abandoned stations on foot, and make strategic decisions as you push deeper into the deep space.

apps.name: Solid Boat Adventure
apps.short_description: Solid Boat Adventure is a co-op adventure game where you and your friends control an odd steamboat delivering curious cargo across treacherous waters.

apps.name: Solid River
apps.short_description: Thrive in a realistic environment where crafting, building, and survival meet the intrigue of medieval life. Construct inspiring structures and cultivate a community of loyal villagers. Your ingenuity is your strength. Your will is your weapon.

apps.name: Spaceborn Awakening
apps.short_description: Start as a mortal. End as a god. Carve through corrupted hordes, evolve your arsenal and unlock cosmic powers that clear the screen with a wave of your hand. A narrative-driven bullet-heaven roguelite.

apps.name: Spartacus Blood Arena
apps.short_description:
Fight for freedom through intense, tactical battles, crafted with the expertise of archaeology departments and reenactors from Rome, Capua, and Pompeii.
Prepare for glory. Prepare for blood!!!!

apps.name: Speed Goes Up
apps.short_description: Race, earn, upgrade, repeat. Turn faster laps into Bits, build a fleet of income generating Ghosts, master drift powered boost, race other cars, and push your vehicle to its limits

apps.name: SPH: Neon Geometry Survivor
apps.short_description: Neon geometry arcade survivor. Aim, dash and blast endless neon hordes with 12 weapons and 5 heroes, climb two global leaderboards, and clear a 20-level campaign with 4 boss showdowns. A fast, stylish twin-stick roguelite.

apps.name: Spirit Crossing
apps.short_description: From the makers of Cozy Grove: Glide through pastel clouds, help lost spirits along the way, and design your own home nestled high on a mountain peak. Befriend strangers around a warm campfire, or share memories while lazily fishing in the sky with a friend. Welcome to your strange new home. 🏠🏔️

apps.name: Spooker
apps.short_description: A roguelite pool-like game of cursed billiards. Turn the tables in your favor by stacking combos, cranking up multipliers, and breaking the game wide open. It’s the only way you’ll ever leave this place.

apps.name: Spooky Ride
apps.short_description: Team up in 1–4 player co-op, hop on your bikes, and ride into a supernatural forest in search of BIGFOOT. Follow strange clues, survive ghostly encounters, solve co-op puzzles, and try to make it back before your crew becomes another forest legend.

apps.name: Spot the Difference Fighter
apps.short_description:
Fighting games meet spot-the-difference! Find the differences and KO your opponent!
No complicated controls—just sharp eyes and quick reflexes! Chain combos and compete against players from around the world!

apps.name: SqueakOut
apps.short_description: A chaotic 1-4 player co-op game where laboratory mice survive deadly experiments, upgrade their shelter, and build a giant screwdriver to escape a mad scientist.

apps.name: Stand Alone
apps.short_description: Stand Alone is a dynamic real-time strategy game, where players compete to control land in epic multiplayer battles. Engage in intense, tactical warfare as you capture fortresses, manage resources, and forge alliances or betray them all while navigating a world of shifting power and diplomacy.

apps.name: StarBoost
apps.short_description:
Boost, strafe, survive! Test your skill and reaction speed in this action-packed sci-fi racing game. 
Experience thrilling 360° parcour racing on your path to becoming the intergalactic champion. Be fast, make risky jumps, blasts and fight your way to the top.
Can you win the Tournament?

apps.name: Starfall Chronicles
apps.short_description: Starfall Chronicles is a single-player 2D loot RPG. Skills cast themselves: dodge in combat, tune gear and shape builds outside it. Three classes, artifacts, gear sets and stat counters make every gear choice count. Face four difficulty tiers and a 100-floor tower. Buy once, no microtransactions.

apps.name: Stargazer Simulator
apps.short_description: Go from zero to a real amateur astronomer. Join the astronomy club, set up your own telescope, start with your first bright star, and go on to find the Moon’s craters and distant galaxies in the real night sky. Every star you learn in the game is really up there tonight.

apps.name: STAR³
apps.short_description: STAR³ is a cosy 3D logic puzzle where colours wrap around cubes and your thoughts become music. Solve puzzles, awaken stars and build your constellation. No timer. No lives. Just a little curiosity and a universe to bring to life.

apps.name: Steal A Coffin
apps.short_description: Steal coffins, collect rare monsters, and turn their income into speed. Train on your treadmill to reach distant biomes and haul back better loot. Upgrade your gear and occasionally steal a coffin right out of another player's hands.

apps.name: Stella Sora
apps.short_description: Stella Sora is a free-to-play light-action fantasy RPG. Join the Trekkers to battle, conquer mysterious labyrinths called "Monoliths," explore the vibrant continent of Nova, and uncover secrets buried beneath the sands.

apps.name: Stellar Ascendancy
apps.short_description: Build an interstellar civilization in a turn-based 4X strategy game. Explore a configurable galaxy, colonize new worlds, design warships, manage a complex economy, and outmaneuver rival empires through diplomacy, espionage, or war.

apps.name: Stellar Shipyard
apps.short_description: Stellar Shipyard is a space colony sandbox where you design modular ships and stations, and automate resource production using drones and workers. Let the automated systems fly even the most improvised designs. Face rival factions and threats solo, or alongside friends as allies or rivals.

apps.name: Steps into Corruption
apps.short_description: A kinetic adult visual novel about a young married couple diving into swinging and open relationships. Play as the husband as curiosity quickly turns into temptation in an explicit NTR/NTS story of jealousy, desire and a marriage that will never be the same.

apps.name: Strange Dreams
apps.short_description: You inherited a house in another town. When you arrived, it was cold and raining, so you went straight to bed. That was mistake. You fell into a deep, dangerous dream where an entity will force you through increasingly strange and terrifying stages of sleep. Want to wake up? Find a way out.

apps.name: Stuntman: Hollywood
apps.short_description: Become Hollywood's most sought-after stuntman. Perform explosive scenes inspired by blockbuster movies, defy danger, and drift your way to stardom.

apps.name: Stupid Never Dies
apps.short_description: Turn weak zombie Davy stupid strong, stupid fast in this Blazing Fast Growth action RPG! Devour enemies, steal powers, transform, and brave a deadly dungeon to revive frozen Julia.

apps.name: SummaGrande
apps.short_description: A friendly math card game for two. Combine number cards to hit each task's target value, chain multipliers, and beat the clock. Play solo against AI or online with a friend — built to make arithmetic fun at school and at home.

apps.name: Super Yooka-Laylee Kart
apps.short_description: The most skilful, expressive and explosive racer built around mastery, rivalry, and revenge-fuelled comebacks. Race through a solo campaign, compete against rivals online, or create your own custom race setups and challenge your friends.

apps.name: Superpower Rally: Home Guard
apps.short_description: Relaxing light roguelike tower defense! Roguelike progression, plant hero growth, selectable super plants, day/night modes. Awakened plants vs zombies—collect plants, unlock skills, upgrade sun economy, defend your home. Low-spec friendly for tower defense and roguelike Build fans.

apps.name: SuperReap
apps.short_description: Super Reap is a cozy active incremental harvesting game where you swing your scythe through wildly overgrown crops, sell resources for coins, unlock talents, skill cards, gear, and new harvesting methods, and transform a rundown farm into an efficient reaping paradise.

apps.name: Survival Float Simulator - Crocodile Waters Craft, Raft, Build
apps.short_description: Survive the dangerous swamp on a floating raft. Gather resources, craft tools, catch fish, purify water, expand your shelter, and defend yourself from hungry crocodiles lurking beneath the surface.

apps.name: Sushiamo
apps.short_description:
Sushiamo is a roguelike deck-builder where you make sushi to reach absurd scores. 
Discover unique ingredients, sauces, game-changing tools, and navigate the map to break the game with insane combos!

apps.name: Swish and Flick: Tidy Up Together
apps.short_description: A wizard duel has wrecked the wand shop: thousands of magical objects lie scattered across its rooms. Sort wands, potions, runes and candles back where they belong, cast tidying spells, and watch every room wake up in a burst of magic. Play solo or with up to three friends.

apps.name: Swornhand
apps.short_description: A dark fantasy tactical card game with a story campaign, deckbuilding and online duels planned for launch. Discover 480 cards, fight for control of 3×3 and 4×4 boards, and challenge another player on the same computer.

apps.name: Systemic War
apps.short_description: Lead your nation in a modern grand strategy game (2008–2025), using a macroeconomic model with exchange rates, diplomacy, and hybrid warfare. Engage in kinetic warfare on the strategic map, then shift to RTS battles at focal points.

apps.name: Tabletop TD
apps.short_description: A random tower defense around a tavern table, where everyone guards their own board. Draw towers with gold, from Spearman to Railgun, and set them by hand beside the rail. Merge three of a kind to grow stronger; it never fails. One lucky draw can turn the board around. Hold out solo or with friends.

apps.name: Taise-CityVsBus
apps.short_description: This city has been swallowed by apocalyptic chaos. The crew entered the streets before you and are still fighting. You are the bus driver. Drive through the city and rescue the scattered crew in this exhilarating apocalyptic bus action game!

apps.name: TALLREAPER
apps.short_description: A seemingly simple task given to you by the Baron, turns into living hell, revealing a dark, surreal and introspective story, as you - a prisoner - are tasked with obtaining a fallen knights sword inside an underground crypt.

apps.name: TankRat
apps.short_description:
A dying world, flesh given way to steel. Swarms of corrupted mech-monsters roam a desolated land. Search and destroy, scavenge and dismantle, rebuild yourself from the wreckage. What you take becomes what you are.
Survive the wasteland. Make it to Highpoint.

apps.name: Tanuki Tag
apps.short_description: This ain't your grandma's hide-and-seek! Stretch, squash, and shape yourself into ridiculous disguises. Go tiny, go HUGE, blend into your surroundings, and cause absolute chaos with your friends! For 2–8 players.

apps.name: Tap Monster: Saga
apps.short_description: Welcome to the world of monsters — an idle collection game where you can recruit every boss, flexibly switch formations, and discover new solutions on every map.

apps.name: TeamSpec
apps.short_description: The class-based shooter where you can make your own class, both in terms of gameplay and looks!

apps.name: Television Dynasty Manager
apps.short_description: Take over your own station at the dawn of television and turn it into America's greatest TV dynasty. Produce your own series, shows and films, secure the best programs, build studios, expand your broadcast area and plan the perfect schedule. But the competition never sleeps.

apps.name: Tenshi Gun Gun
apps.short_description: A fast-paced angelic run‑and‑gun platformer with twin‑stick shooting, fluid movement, and a unique dual‑weapon system.

apps.name: The Abyss Break
apps.short_description: Hardcore first-person co-op horror game. Explore the worlds beyond the Abyss alone or with a team, gather what you need to survive, and discover how far consciousness can change before it is no longer your own.

apps.name: The Apothecary Diaries: The False Imperial Brother
apps.short_description: Investigate mysteries, craft medicine, and uncover the truth in this brand-new story from The Apothecary Diaries. Explore the rear palace and capital to gather evidence and question witnesses, then assemble what you've learned into theories and deductions to solve thrilling mysteries in this sprawling adventure game.

apps.name: The Crown Must Endure
apps.short_description: Rule a medieval kingdom where every decision has a consequence. Settle disputes, manage scarce resources, and defend your castle against invading armies. Your choices shape who stands beside you, who betrays you, and how your reign will be remembered.

apps.name: The Cube Will Kill You
apps.short_description: Trapped in a shifting 7x7x7 cube of trap rooms, up to 8 players race for the one exit. Only the first one out survives, everybody else burns. Grab items, bluff with flags, bomb your rivals. Trust no one.

apps.name: The Dinosaur League
apps.short_description: A dinosaur-raising team battle game.

apps.name: The Dust Between: Observer
apps.short_description: A 1-4 player co-op horror strategy game where you guide unseen clients, draw the map, send commands, solve cases, and survive the dangers inside your own office.

apps.name: The Gaffer
apps.short_description: For anyone who misses the football management games of the 80s. Start in the Fourth Division in 1959 and manage thirty seasons of English football by the real rules of each season, while your board, your pub and your town remember every result and every excuse.

apps.name: The Hidden Evils Club
apps.short_description:
When Weird Hill begins to fall, a strange school club becomes the town’s last line of defense.

Build towers, manage resources, trade with survivors, command unusual heroes, and protect the heart of the town from escalating zombie waves.

apps.name: The Hidden Ones
apps.short_description: The Hidden Ones is a cooperative horror puzzle game that supports four-player online multiplayer. An seemingly ordinary fire incident unravels the prologue to a cold case that has been buried in a small town , binding the fates of four protagonists into an eerie and intricate maze of mystery.

apps.name: The Inkwell
apps.short_description: Monitor. Identify. Purge. Watch haunted cartoon feeds, identify entities by the anomalies they leave behind, and perform precise exorcisms. Keep the corruption contained, or the broadcast will claim you next.

apps.name: The Legend of California
apps.short_description: The Legend of California is an open world, action-survival shooter set on the mythical Island of California during the gold rush era. Explore a vast, untamed frontier and forge your legacy alone or with friends.

apps.name: The Legend of Pepino
apps.short_description: Level up your character, battle hordes of monsters, earn money to unlock items and spells for your class, and face powerful bosses along the way.

apps.name: The Lords Next Door
apps.short_description: Your fighting days are over. Settle a little frontier town, hire heroes at the tavern and clear the monster camps in the woods. Then get to know the lords next door: visit, swap gifts and stand guard for each other when raiders come over the border.

apps.name: The Lost Wild
apps.short_description: True fear is primal. Embark on an evasion-based survival horror experience against nature’s ultimate hunters — dinosaurs. Explore overgrown research facilities nestled in a lush wilderness. Be resourceful as you evade, distract, survive, and unravel the mystery at the heart of the island.

apps.name: The Marquee: Lights. Camera. Legacy.
apps.short_description: Build a film studio from the ground up, create original movies, manage talent and production, compete for audiences, and turn unexpected successes into a cinematic legacy.

apps.name: The Ninth Witch’s Jail
apps.short_description: The Ninth Witch's Jail is an anomaly-hunt game with a crunchy retro aesthetic set in the Medieval era. Spot the signs of curses or witchcraft in the prison to break out of an endless loop, continue your exploration and confront the ninth witch.

apps.name: The Pink Robot
apps.short_description: The Pink Robot is a fast-paced isometric action roguelite with deep build variety and fluid combat. Create powerful synergies through skills and mementos, and face relentless challenges that grow stronger with every run.

apps.name: The Pond
apps.short_description: Lovecraft horror merging puzzle game with a unique story set in the world and lore of tinymancer.

apps.name: The Studio - Indie Grind
apps.short_description: Build a game that generates a million dollar in revenue. Or sell a million units. 10 turns is all you get. Raise capital, hire a team, pick a genre, manage productivity, run launch, clean up post launch mess. All in a days work. How hard could it be? Minimalist, 2D, Economy, Turn based strategy.

apps.name: The Trivia Show
apps.short_description: Chaotic multiplayer for up to 8 friends. Think fast, dodge traps and turn the tables. A question hits the screen, the clock runs, and every wrong answer sets off the room: exploding platforms, ankle bombs, a revolver on the table and much more.

apps.name: The Warden's Rite
apps.short_description: The Warden's Rite is a fantasy tower defense game set in a world consumed by the Fire God. You are humanity's last hope. As the Warden, command Earth, Air, and Water with the power of the Elemental Gods. Combine elements to create traps, block paths, and place towers to set your strategy.

apps.name: They Will Come
apps.short_description: Survive a nightmare and save your family. They Will Come is a cinematic steampunk horror adventure set in an alternate 1897. You must avoid detection, solve puzzles, and fight back against mysterious enemies with the help of your powerful robot companion, Talus.

apps.name: Thicc Rogue
apps.short_description:
“Thicc Rogue” is a roguelike RPG.
Form a party with adventurers you’ve freely customized and conquer dungeons.
Lead your one-of-a-kind adventurers to break through dangerous, unexplored labyrinths.
But here’s the catch: all the female adventurers must be “Thicc”!

apps.name: Thief: The Dark Project Remastered
apps.short_description: The shadows are your ally. Return to the city as Garrett, master thief, in this remastered classic by Nightdive Studios. Pickpocket, prowl, and outsmart in a world where trust is a luxury and every stolen secret comes at a price.

apps.name: THIS IS TORTURE TOGETHER
apps.short_description: THIS IS TORTURE TOGETHER is an online co-op horror game for 1-4 players, following a structured campaign with randomized elements. Abducted by a sinister kidnapper, you now must escape his deranged facility, survive twisted abominations, solve puzzles, and reach one of several endings.

apps.name: Ties: Soul Link
apps.short_description: TIES: Soul Link is an emotional and brutal 2D metroidvania that combines action RPG with adventure platforming. Explore a decaying world in the year 2097, uncover its secrets, and face savage, bloody battles that will test your endurance and your deepest fears.

apps.name: Time For Changes
apps.short_description: During exam prep, Semyon faces a family crisis that leads to failure and a transfer to a troubled class. There, he encounters not only hostility but also makes new friends and meets girls who change his outlook on life. He must make tough choices between friendship, dreams, and harsh reality.

apps.name: TIME JOURNEY
apps.short_description: This game is perfect for players who relish sci-fi mysteries, engaging storylines, and intellectual challenges. "Time Journey" invites you to decipher the secrets of your identity and the alien lab, making every discovery a step closer to the truth.

apps.name: Tiny Dwellings
apps.short_description: Tiny Dwellings is a cozy pixel-art builder with over 1,000 hand drawn items to place, decorate, and unwind with. Create charming little homes and tiny dioramas at your own pace, surrounded by calm lo-fi vibes, soft lighting, and cozy ambience.

apps.name: Titanic Survival Simulator Together
apps.short_description: 🚢 Titanic Survival Simulator Together is a cooperative survival game aboard the sinking Titanic. Explore the massive ship, find a way to safety, and survive the cold, darkness, rising water, and deteriorating sanity. Play alone or with up to 4 players. 🧊🌊

apps.name: Todd is Late
apps.short_description: Todd is Late is a FMV point and click hidden-object game that pits you not only against the clock, but also against your own ability to plan and adapt with every attempt. Help guide Todd out the door with everything he needs in time for his big day at work.

apps.name: Tom the Postgirl
apps.short_description: Join Tom, the village’s new postgirl, and get to know the locals, perhaps a little too well. Her method, although controversial, is highly effective: intense, obsessive stalking.

apps.name: Total Blade: Mythology
apps.short_description:
Lead over 3400 soldiers in massive real-time battles across a vast 16th-century world from Europe to Japan.
Conquer cities, recruit famous historical figures, and forge your empire in a grand sandbox RPG

apps.name: Trick or Eat
apps.short_description: Halloween night, and the monsters are going door to door. Whoever opens up gets eaten. Defend the neighbourhood solo or with up to three friends: fight ghouls, witches and werewolves, spend your candy on upgrades, and if you fall, rise again as one of the monsters.

apps.name: Trick-Taking Rogue
apps.short_description:
Trick-Taking × Roguelike!
Trick-taking games fused with roguelike elements like skills and shops!
Features 9 trick-taking games including Spades, Oh Hell, and Schnapsen!

apps.name: Trine 6: Together in Time
apps.short_description: Trine 6: Together in Time is a co-op puzzle platformer for 1–4 players. Wit, timing, and teamwork collide as you solve perplexing puzzles, engage cunning creatures, and traverse perilous paths in the next adventure through Trine’s iconic fairytale world.

apps.name: TRIROAD
apps.short_description: A turn-based board game for 2! Place triangle pieces in turn and be first to connect two of your colored spots on the board's edge. Decided within 24 moves, yet no one knows if a winning strategy exists. With a reinforcement-learning AI, 50 puzzles and an editor, a real-time 3D mode and online play.

apps.name: TRUCK SIMULATOR US DRIVER
apps.short_description: Live the life of a truck driver in TRUCK SIMULATOR US DRIVER. Travel across open roads, complete jobs, manage your needs, upgrade your truck, and build your path in a world driven by distance and time.

apps.name: TSAREVNA. Age of Tales
apps.short_description: The world's first ballet-inspired action. Become the Tsarevna and carve your way through a dark Slavic fairy tale where beauty becomes a weapon. Chain stylish combos, master graceful swordplay, and turn every battle into a deadly dance.

apps.name: Tubular Tides
apps.short_description: Grab your trusty innertube and explore a colorful world in Tubular Tides. Meet quirky locals, take on quests, fish, hunt for hidden treasure and follow your curiosity to uncover the forgotten past.

apps.name: Type 'n Hatch
apps.short_description: A cozy desktop companion that hatches hand-drawn birds as you type. Every key you press, in any app, cracks the egg on that key, and the birds that hatch hop around your keyboard. Pomodoro tomatoes, a CRT typing race, and magic words to discover along the way.

apps.name: Tyrants Must Fall
apps.short_description: In this turn-based tactical roguelike, build an army to triumph in fast-paced battles. Deploy your troops, plan your attack, and watch as the action plays out simultaneously. Unlock powerful formations and guide the Hero of Destiny as he topples the Tyrant King!

apps.name: UBAI Ending
apps.short_description: Ryousuke is suddenly confronted with a difficult decision regarding the future of Ubai.

apps.name: UFO98
apps.short_description: UFO98 is a retro incremental simulation game set on an isolated Win98 desktop. Decrypt encrypted alien signals, leak top-secret files, and defy an oppressive government to awaken humanity to the truth.

apps.name: UN:Me
apps.short_description: UN:Me is a soul triage adventure. Four souls share one girl’s body, each certain it is the real one, yet only one can remain. Through dialogue you search a beautiful, unsettling world for its true owner, fleeing the traumas that surface as you go. When only one can stay, which will you keep?

apps.name: Under The Basement
apps.short_description: A survival horror game where you must escape ancient claustrophobic caves filled with terrifying threats. Climb, crawl, and fight to survive, but beware: nothing in this place wants you there. What if your only way out was to run, but running could bring the entire place crashing down?

apps.name: UNDERFED
apps.short_description: An underground survival game built on proximity voice chat. Every sound in the dark is another person. The deeper you go, the harder it is to get back out.

apps.name: Underground Sweeper
apps.short_description: A side-scrolling exploration game with light looting and incremental progression. Explore underground ruins, defeat monsters, collect and sell loot, upgrade your gear and abilities, venture deeper, and pay off your debt.

apps.name: Undying Knights
apps.short_description: Undying Knights is a couch and online party game that fuses strategy and reflexes. Enjoy quick rounds with flexible team fights, unique weapons and deadly traps, all with a handicap option that keeps every battle fair.

apps.name: Unframed
apps.short_description: Rob a bank with your friends, keep the loot in one piece and watch out for the traitor. Unframed is a physics-based heist game for 3–6 players. Help your crew or tape up someone you don’t trust. Just remember: the getaway vehicle is one seat short.

apps.name: Unnatural Worlds
apps.short_description:
Innovative yet familiar real-time strategy game in development.
Grand-scale RTS game played on maps/planets of any 3D shape.
It emphasizes strategy, base building, logistics, and reduces micro-management of individual units.

apps.name: Unrecord
apps.short_description:
Unrecord is a single-player FPS that tells the story of a tactical police officer from the perspective of his body camera.
As you work to solve a complex case, you'll need to use your tactical and detective skills to succeed.

apps.name: Unscrewed
apps.short_description: Run a cozy recycling depot at golden hour. Drill out every screw from chairs, fridges, arcade cabinets and more, watch them wobble and collapse in a satisfying heap, sort the scraps for cash, hunt rare finds and upgrade your drills in this chill physics sim.

apps.name: Usagi Shima: Bunny Island
apps.short_description: Welcome to Usagi Shima! Build your own bunny paradise, attract fluffy tourists with toys and decorations, and befriend lovable bunnies by feeding, petting, and playing with them. Relax with rabbits in a beautiful sandbox of your own design.

apps.name: Vaewolf
apps.short_description:
Half-werewolf, half-vampire… all vengeance. 

Unleash your relentless wrath in a brutal, ceaseless quest for revenge in a bold Hack and Slash power fantasy set in the untamed English North.

apps.name: Vault Keeper: Tidy Up the Vault
apps.short_description: "Vault Keeper" is a single-player, therapeutic organization game. You will put over 50 thousands of banknotes and collectibles back in place. Learn to organize efficiently and complete the task faster than anyone else!

apps.name: VECTORHYTHM
apps.short_description: Turn rhythm into firepower in a neon bullet heaven. Time your attacks to charge Power and strengthen your weapons, build devastating synergies in Survivors mode, or chase high scores in quick Arcade runs as every song drives the fight.

apps.name: Vegelypse
apps.short_description: Vegelypse is a hand-painted 2.5D beat 'em up with roguelite twists. Join the Hard Rock Cacti Band, master brutal combos, and crush hordes of vicious mutant fruits and vegetables in a chaotic fight to save the city! The Vegelypse has begun!

apps.name: Very Safe Dino Park 🦖
apps.short_description: A chaotic 1 to 4 player dinosaur park sim where feeding the dinos, cleaning the mess, and surviving the chaos are all part of the job.

apps.name: Veterans: Napoleonic Wars
apps.short_description: Command thousands of soldiers in a Napoleonic real-time strategy game where every volley matters. Win through quick decisions and well-chosen formations. Preserve your troops, develop veteran units, and turn the tide of battle.

apps.name: Vice Club Simulator
apps.short_description: Build your own nightclub from zero to hero in Vice Club Simulator! Hire talented dancers, build deep relationships with your girls, and create the hottest lineup in town. Manage the chaos, grow your club, and keep the party going until sunrise!

apps.name: Viking Colony Builder Valhalla
apps.short_description: Build and expand a thriving Viking settlement. Manage resources, develop trade, train your colonists, fortify your lands, and lead warriors into tactical battles, daring raids, and new conquests.

apps.name: Wandersky
apps.short_description: Wandersky is a skybound top-down adventure with a single arrow and a flying house. Kuu and her companion Tama are on a mission to restore the land of Hyndara. Explore a huge world filled with puzzles, enemies and quests: the sky always carries those who dare to wander…

apps.name: Want a Bomb?
apps.short_description: Explore an island in search of the Sun Gem, solo or with up to 4 players online. Blast through mountains, sell ore, research and upgrade your gear, and take on monsters. From chain reactions to launchers that send friends flying, carve your own path!

apps.name: Warding Witches
apps.short_description: Warding Witches offers a classic, unapologetic bullet hell shoot ‘em up challenge while also putting defense into players’ hands. Experience an adrenaline-filled flow alternating between attacking, defending and dodging, amplified by an intuitive scoring system that weaves into gameplay seamlessly.

apps.name: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV
apps.short_description: Return to the RTS series’ roots with deeply satisfying strategy gameplay. Take command of four unique Warhammer 40,000 factions, including the Adeptus Mechanicus in their series debut! Fight through 70+ epic campaign missions, as well as the replayable Last Stand, Skirmish and multiplayer modes.

apps.name: Warhammer Age Of Sigmar: Deathmaster
apps.short_description: Play a sneaky, ruthless Skaven assassin and slay your way up the ranks of the ratmen in this grim and dark new 2D stealth-action platformer. Escape. Kill. Ascend. Become a Deathmaster.

apps.name: Warmasters
apps.short_description: A turn-based hex wargame where the deck decides who fights. Draw a Battle card, call up knights or archers or a war machine, and make a plan survive the order it is dealt. Two rulesets: a clean card game, or the full tabletop with nerve, toughness and charges.

apps.name: Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest
apps.short_description: Create your own Warrior Cat and journey through the Lake Territories in an immersive action-adventure inspired by the beloved Warrior Cats book series. Hunt, explore, battle rival Clans, uncover prophecies, and shape your legacy with every choice you make.

apps.name: Water Me and You
apps.short_description: A cozy co-op adventure in which you play as a water or seed-like character, changing states and rebuilding a world left behind by humans.

apps.name: We Were Here Tomorrow
apps.short_description: You and your partner awaken inside a mysterious Norček facility with little recollection of how you got there. Communicate, cooperate, and unravel the secrets in this asymmetrical co-op adventure. Only together will you decide the fate of Tomorrow…

apps.name: Wesley Smith's Repair Game
apps.short_description: Help Wesley Smith to collect items, craft weapons and defeat his opponents in this frustratingly funny arcade game. Compete against the merciless bots or up to three friends in couch co-op mode to become the master blacksmith!

apps.name: Wetland
apps.short_description: Dare enter the cursed swamp with your friends. Find the hidden Lab. Extract the Artifact. Get out alive. But as hallucinations spread, reality fractures. You saw it. They swear it never happened. Who will you trust? Who will you fight? Can you still trust your own mind?

apps.name: We’re In Trouble
apps.short_description: A CO-OP stealth game about a problem that can’t wait until morning. 🕵️‍♂️ An empty office, a body, and absolute silence. Work together, avoid guards and cameras, handle unpredictable physics, and escape unnoticed. One mistake can ruin everything.

apps.name: What the Buck?!
apps.short_description: What the Buck?! is a satisfying incremental game about destroying money. Shred stacks of cash, set off chain reactions across the table, prestige for permanent upgrades and automate your money destruction. Your demo progress carries over to the full game.

apps.name: Where is My Pet?
apps.short_description: Where is My Pet? is a hidden object, sorting, and animal game! Run your cozy shelter: place animals, sell them to loving homes, upgrade your shelter, build your dream house, and search the city for pets. Can you turn a shabby shelter into a profitable business?

apps.name: Where is my sword
apps.short_description:
A mismatched duo—a wicked demon god and a kind-hearted fox girl—is gathering followers!?
Travel across many lands and survive hectic yet strategic real-time battles by rummaging through your bag for just the right item!
Fight your foes or turn them into followers... What awaits at journey's end?

apps.name: Who's the Biggest Degen?
apps.short_description: You and 3 friends owe Tony the Octopus a lot of money. Gamble on 30 casino games across 8 floors, slap, rob and sabotage each other, and pay Tony every night, or he takes your stuff, pants included. After 5 nights, only one of you is the Biggest Degen.

apps.name: Wielders of the Essence
apps.short_description: Single-player horde survival with a touch of incremental base building. Cast spells, command troops, and take your town from puddle to paradise. Eight-minute runs. Eight hours to complete.

apps.name: Wild West Canyon
apps.short_description: Revolver in hand, bison in sight: Experience a ruthless survival adventure. Defy wild animals and Native Americans. Build a refuge and show who is in charge!

apps.name: Wilderdark
apps.short_description: Something dangerous is lurking in the wilderness. Wilderdark is a first-person survival horror game where you must navigate a strange island inhabited by ectoparasitic dinosaurs and organisms. You must remain vigilant to stealthily obtain evidence, samples, and craft items to survive.

apps.name: Windfall Meadows
apps.short_description: Choose a hero and survive relentless swarms in a colorful 3D meadow. Attacks fire automatically as you dodge enemies, collect experience, choose upgrades and battle recurring bosses. Play as an archer, warrior, mage or druid.

apps.name: Wobblebound
apps.short_description: A physics stacking roguelite where every toy has a face. Draft toys and lucky charms at every bell, beat wind, thunder and snow, unlock 37 charms and 8 harder levels, then race or build one tower together with up to four players on one PC.

apps.name: WOIM
apps.short_description: WOIM is a puzzle game where you play as a worm! Push blocks, flip switches, eat apples and... cut yourself in half! WOIM will push you to keep digging downwards, solving tricky puzzles, finding secrets, and making new friends (that were once part of you).

apps.name: Wreckreation 2
apps.short_description:
Wreckreation 2 is a return to classic arcade racing where every race is a battle.
Winning means driving fast, taking risks and knowing when to race and when to fight.

apps.name: Wyrmspan
apps.short_description: Wyrmspan is an engine-building, card-driven strategy game for 1 to 5 players. Play as an amateur dracologist discovering a world of dragons. Excavate caves and explore your sanctuary. Entice dragons and chain their abilities to create powerful combos.

apps.name: Xenomire
apps.short_description: XENOMIRE is a 2D sci-fi horror extraction shooter. Descend to a contaminated alien planet, complete contracts, gather loot, and extract before the horrors lurking there tear you apart. Upgrade your gear and create unique builds for each high-risk expedition.

apps.name: YokaiRun 巡妖
apps.short_description:
Oops! The master's away and the monsters escaped!
Can the rookie who started this mess clean it up?
Don't expect expert heroics. You've only got half-baked spells and wobbly kung fu. Turn this fail into your comeback story!

apps.name: You're Nuts!
apps.short_description: Wake up, little robot: it's time to plan your escape. Solo or with up to 3 friends, crack the factory's puzzles, craft gear, open shortcuts and upgrade your base to go faster and further every day, until you carry the key to the exit. Set it up your way, from super cozy to nearly impossible.

apps.name: YuanRong
apps.short_description:
"Ten great war-chariots lead the vanguard." — Shijing
2D turn-based tactical RPG. Four cultural origins, procedurally generated continents, individual soldier recruitment and training, chain-of-command formations, hex-grid combat, fight outnumbered.

apps.name: zenaimu
apps.short_description: A slime pen for your desktop! Make your workspace 10x cuter with slimes that bounce around while you use your PC. Try your luck at the gachaclaw each day to get new slimes for your collection!

apps.name: ZERO Sievert 2
apps.short_description: ZERO Sievert 2 is a top-down PvE extraction shooter set in the ruined country of Zakov. Hunt alone or with a crew, face anomalies, bandits, and mutants, and make it out alive.

apps.name: Zombie Royale
apps.short_description: Zombie Royale is a single-player or multi-player 3rd-person shooter set in a future reality TV show where contestants fight to the death for money, in a deadly world of genetically engineered Zombies, Cyborgs, and Ghosts.

apps.name: Пятизвёздочный курьер и туман, воняющий мертвечиной
apps.short_description: Experience the work of a courier in a city of living rumors and legends. Pay off your debt by carrying out strange requests from mystical customers. Uncover the reason behind the appearance of a mysterious fog that smells of decay.

apps.name: ゆめみるサクラの卒業式
apps.short_description: 卒業式は、何度でも壊れていく。友だちのどちらに先に話しかけるかを選ぶだけの、何気ない一日のはずだった。話しかける順番で会話の内容が変わり、周回を重ねるたびに景色が少しずつ歪んでいく。仲の良い友だちの顔から、なぜか笑顔が消えていく。真実に気づいた時、その卒業式はもう、はじめの卒業式ではない。これは友情を描いたノベルアドベンチャーです。周回を重ねるほど、目を背けたくなる真実に近づいていきます。壊れるところまで、丁寧に。

apps.name: ゆるキャン△ つなげるみんなのオールインワン!! ちるタイム
apps.short_description: Right beside you as you sit at your desk, Rin, Nadeshiko, and the others are out camping again today. You can focus on your work or studies while watching them. Create your own unique campsite using over 1,000 types of gear, and watch your focused time accumulate in your diary.

apps.name: オーダーバーガー
apps.short_description:
[Overview]
"Order's Burger" is a fast-paced action game where you stack ingredients to match incoming orders.   [Key Features]Fast-paced ingredient stacking   Increasing difficulty levels   Time attack & high score rankings   Test your reflexes and become the ultimate burger master!

apps.name: クイズ！罵倒ネア！
apps.short_description: This game is a quiz game that includes satire and jokes.

apps.name: ケロロ軍曹☆ ハチャメチャTVショー 　～賞金ゲット大作戦であります！～
モグモグ！クソバトル
apps.short_description: Control a 🥕, gather 🐰, and feed them to 🐺 with your teammate! Eaten 🐰 turn into 💩 and get SHOOT at the enemy! 2v2 online battle for up to 4 players. Play solo or with friends!

apps.name: モノノケの国
apps.short_description: Restore villages, purify yokai, and reclaim a lost world in this Japanese-inspired action-adventure set in an otherworld inhabited by Mononoke. Journey through the corrupted Mononoke no Kuni, recover the stolen soul of Musashi the Shiba Inu, and set out on a grand adventure to return home.

apps.name: 人性转世
apps.short_description: Make peace with yourself.You never needed to regret that choice.

apps.name: 再再启程 One Way Tickets
apps.short_description: “One Way Tickets” is a roguelite incremental adventure game where you embark on a exciting journey in a fantasy world. Choose your vehicle, equip your device and face challenges from all kinds of enemies. Ram! Unload bullets! Swing with all your might! Keep growing and push forward!

apps.name: 夜酌星河：吧台物语
apps.short_description: A lighthearted visual novel about bartending. A century after humanity reached the stars, Nana is just a bartender on Blue Star — serving drinks, listening to her guests, learning the universe. And if she can, she might change the world with one small glass.

apps.name: 大烟枪
apps.short_description: I Got Smoke is a pixel-art, top-down action game. Play as a traditional cigarette and kill every vape. Gunfights, close combat, executions—kill everything you see, or be killed.

apps.name: 我在大厂搞外包
apps.short_description: A darkly comic workplace visual novel set inside a Chinese tech giant. Decide what programmer Lin Mo believes, what he says aloud, and which records he keeps. Your choices reshape credit, access, relationships, and the truth left behind across seven endings.

apps.name: 末日下班特快
apps.short_description: My coworkers turned into zombies—and they’re still making me work overtime! Recruit passengers and unleash surprising combos with double-sided cards in this roguelike deckbuilder.

apps.name: 火柴：人在异世
apps.short_description: Choose from heroes with radically different playstyles and build a unique deck in a dangerous otherworld. Combine cards, relics, and character mechanics to create powerful combat engines and overcome three escalating stages of adventure.

apps.name: 灵能中介所 Ghost Hunting Journal
apps.short_description: Ghost Hunting Journal is an anime-style narrative adventure game. Follow a duo of self-proclaimed “Spirit Agents” as they take on supernatural cases, use a range of ghost-hunting techniques, and investigate urban legends surrounding the lingering spirits of Riverrun.

apps.name: 真・竹取物語 / Shin Taketori Monogatari
apps.short_description:
Everyone knows The Tale of the Bamboo Cutter — but the retelling twisted it. This was once something that happened.
On the far side of the moon, a woman wakes with no memory. Trace what she lost; your choices shape the ending.
—Precious, because it ends. A pixel-art sci-fi sound novel.

apps.name: 结丹模拟器
apps.short_description: Build a cultivation factory inside your body. Study an ancient manual, guide and refine qi by hand, then automate your cultivation with meridians and methods. Manage spiritual sense, clear away turbidity, and form your core before your lifespan runs out.

apps.name: 莫比乌斯环
apps.short_description: A story-driven visual novel set in a fictional parallel world. Make choices, explore branching storylines, and uncover the secrets behind a fateful encounter. This is an unofficial, free fan-made project featuring an entirely fictional story.

apps.name: 赢麻了
apps.short_description: MAHJONG RUSH is a relaxing ink-wash roguelike. Score by matching mahjong tiles into combos — no mahjong experience needed, an interactive tutorial teaches you from scratch. Collect Flowers, Fu cards, and Relics to grow small scores into huge ones. Every run is randomized. This round — clean house.

apps.name: 铸剑者
apps.short_description: Forge every blade with your own hands. Build your sword formation, battle demons from all sides, and protect the one who waits for you — a heartwarming wuxia journey of crafting, roguelite runs and auto-battles.

apps.name: 风吟战记：巨龙残歌
apps.short_description: The Dragon left elusive traces in the world, dancing elves and wandering bards travelling along the world. The magical Astral Spires, slumbered kingdoms, and many more regions are waiting for you to explore. Enter this world with your companions and finally create a heroic epic of your legend!

apps.name: 驱邪师
apps.short_description: Exorcist is a first-person horror role-playing game where players step into the shoes of an exorcist, visit haunted locations, follow clues, complete specific tasks, and gradually uncover the truth behind the haunting

apps.name: Prodigal Soundtrack
apps.short_description: Listen to the sounds of Prodigal anytime and anywhere with the full soundtrack!

apps.name: Tom the Postgirl Soundtrack
apps.short_description:
Step into the strange and unsettling world of Tom the postgirl with the game's original soundtrack.
A collection of creepy-cute tracks inspired by Tom's adventures and the mysterious village she calls home.

apps.name: We Were Here Tomorrow Soundtrack
apps.short_description: The Official We Were Here Tomorrow Soundtrack - Listen to the sounds of an imagined 80s future with 15 tracks of nostalgic synthwave, composed by Tom Wolkers.
